/-- Whether kind `a` refines kind `b`, reflexively and transitively. -/
def StructureKind.refines (a b : StructureKind) : Bool := a == b || a.ancestors.contains b

/-- Whether a source that cannot tell kind `m` (it is among `unobservedKinds`) leaves this structure's
    membership of `m`'s kinds open: always where `m` refines no kind other than an abstract one;
    otherwise only where the structure is labelled `m` or a kind `m` refines, since a structure of any
    other kind is known not to be one. -/
def Structure.maskApplies (st : Structure) (m : StructureKind) : Bool :=
  (m.parent?.filter (!·.isAbstract)).isNone || m.refines st.kind

/-- Whether a structure is of kind `k`: unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
    structure, is `k` or a kind `k` refines (the label cannot be trusted for `k`); true where the
    structure's kind refines `k`; unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
    structure, refines `k`; false otherwise. A parent never implies a kind refining it, two kinds
    refining one parent never imply each other, and a kind the source cannot tell never makes a known
    parent unknown. An abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it: true where the structure
    is of one of them, unknown where it is of none and unknown for one, false otherwise. -/
def Structure.isOfKind (st : Structure) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
  let masked := st.unobservedKinds.filter st.maskApplies
  let concrete (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
    if masked.any (k.refines ·) then none
    else if st.kind.refines k then some true
    else if masked.any (·.refines k) then none
    else some false
  if k.isAbstract then
    let vs := (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k)).map concrete
    if vs.contains (some true) then some true else if vs.contains none then none else some false
  else concrete k

/-- Whether a region is of a kind (`Structure.isOfKind`); unknown for a region not in the scene. -/
def isKind (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
  (s.structure? r).bind (·.isOfKind k)

/-- Geometry accessors every structure atom shares: the reference point and the boundary polygon. -/
def st_region_geometry (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option (Option Vec × Option (List Vec)) :=
  (s.structure? r).map fun st => (st.position, st.boundary)
def st_region_geometry_position (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option Vec := (s.structure? r).bind (·.position)

/-- The rectangle a road user's body covers on the ground, from its position, heading and
    half-extents; `none` when one of them is not observed. -/
def footprint (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List Vec) := do
  let p ← kin_position s x
  let h ← kin_heading s x
  let (hl, hw, _) ← kin_extent s x
  let u ← Geom.unit h
  let v := (Q.neg u.2, u.1)
  let corner (a b : Q) : Vec := Geom.vadd p (Q.add (Q.mul a u.1) (Q.mul b v.1), Q.add (Q.mul a u.2) (Q.mul b v.2))
  pure [corner hl hw, corner hl (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) hw]

/-- Ground distance from a road user's body to a region: zero when the footprint overlaps the
    boundary, otherwise the nearest approach between the two outlines. Without a footprint (no
    extent or heading observed) the reference point is used; a point-like structure is measured
    to its reference point. -/
def st_region_geometry_distance (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Q := do
  let p ← kin_position s x
  match st_region_geometry_boundary s r, footprint s x with
  | some poly, some fp =>
    if Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some Q.zero
    else
      let ds := fp.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · poly) ++ poly.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · fp)
      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
  | some poly, none => Geom.polygonDistance p poly
  | none, fp =>
    let c ← st_region_geometry_position s r
    match fp with
    | some poly => Geom.polygonDistance c poly
    | none => some (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub c p))
/-- The regions present in the scene known to be of a kind (`Structure.isOfKind` true). -/
def regionsOfKind (s : Scene) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (s.structures.filter (·.isOfKind k == some true)).map (·.id)
/-- The regions a quantifier over a kind ranges over: those whose membership of the kind is not
    false (`Structure.isOfKind`), the known members and those that may be members. -/
def regionCandidates (s : Scene) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (s.structures.filter (·.isOfKind k != some false)).map (·.id)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Relations between road users. Measured where the source supplies them, otherwise computed
-- from kinematics. `none` when a needed kinematic is missing.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rel_centre_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.centreDistance) with
  | some d => some d
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    pure (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub pb pa))

/-- Components of `b`'s position relative to `a` in `a`'s heading frame (longitudinal, lateral). -/
private def relFrame (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) := do
  let pa ← kin_position s a
  let pb ← kin_position s b
  let ha ← kin_heading s a
  Geom.inFrame ha (Geom.vsub pb pa)

/-- The gap between the two bodies: the vector from the nearest point of `a`'s footprint to the
    nearest point of `b`'s, each footprint read with its own heading and extent, given as its
    lengths along and across `a`'s heading (longitudinal, lateral). Neither is ever negative; both
    are zero exactly when the footprints touch or overlap. `none` when either footprint is not
    observed, and when a supplied gap has a negative component. -/
def rel_surface_gap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.surfaceGap) with
  | some g => if Q.isNonneg g.1 && Q.isNonneg g.2 then some g else none
  | none => do
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let d ← Geom.nearestOffset fa fb
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let (lon, lat) ← Geom.inFrame ha d
    pure (Q.abs lon, Q.abs lat)
def rel_surface_gap_longitudinal (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.1)
def rel_surface_gap_lateral (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.2)
/-- The distance between the nearest points of the two bodies, the gap's length: zero on contact
    or overlap, never negative. -/
def rel_surface_gap_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map Geom.norm

/-- `a` and `b` share a lane and `a` is ahead of `b` along `a`'s heading. The lane is any region both
    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
    else
      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
      else if shared.contains none then none
      else some false
def rel_ahead_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s a b
def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a

/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let u ← Geom.unit ha
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))

/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    let va ← kin_velocity s a
    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)

/-- Headings aligned (cosine above `cosTol`). -/
def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)

/-- `b` relative to `a` in `a`'s frame: (longitudinal, lateral), lateral positive to the left. -/
def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => relFrame s a b
def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero

/-- The bodies touch or overlap. -/
def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.contact) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero

/-- `b` is in `a`'s line of sight, as the source tested it; never computed. -/
def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)

end TrafficSpec

    (.existsRegion (.lit "crosswalk") "w"

        (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "a"

                (.atom "st_lane_enters" [.var "a", .var "i"] [])))))

            (.cmp (.quantity "prim_closest_approach_distance" [vSubject, .var "u"] [pConflictHorizon])
                  .lt pConflictCentreClearance))
      (.atom "rel_contact" [vSubject, .var "u"] [])

  .implies moving
    (.forallUser "u"
      (.implies (.and (.not (.same vSubject (.var "u"))) (.or pedTarget trafficTarget))
        (.not conflict)))

/-- Every duty, for the arrow direction `dir`, judged at the exit. -/
def duties (dir : String) : Formula :=
  andAll
    [ .since (.not entryI) (.and entryI (forSel dir (.and haltDuty (waitDuty dir))))
    , .implies rightTurn (.since (.not entryI) (.and entryI (forSel dir (noSign "no_right_turn"))))
    , .implies leftTurn (.since (.not entryI) (.and entryI (forSel dir (noSign "no_left_turn"))))
    , .since (.and (.not entryI) yieldsHere) (.and entryI yieldsHere) ]

/-- Class of `subject`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-135::motorcycle, ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-125::moped, ru.motorcycle, ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle, ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484B-017::electric_bicycle, ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484B-018::electric_scooter -/
def clsSubject : Formula :=
  .or (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-135::motorcycle"] [])
    (.or (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-125::moped"] [])
      (.or (.atom "ru_motorcycle" [vSubject] [])
        (.or (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle"] [])
          (.or (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-NRS-484B-017::electric_bicycle"] [])
               (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-NRS-484B-018::electric_scooter"] [])))))

/-- Applicability: s1 (trigger): Where the signal is a steady red with a green turn arrow:; s3 (trigger): facing the signal; s4 (trigger): may proceed straight through or turn in the direction opposite that indicated by the green turn arrow; s8 (condition): to pedestrians lawfully within an adjacent crosswalk; s9 (condition): and to other traffic lawfully using the intersection. -/

import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_307_9b

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/
def vSubject : Arg := .var "subject"

/-- The reading's parameters; no value of any of them lives in this file. -/
def pConflictCentreClearance : Term := .param "p.conflict_centre_clearance"
def pConflictHorizon : Term := .param "p.conflict_horizon"
def pHaltSpeedTolerance : Term := .param "p.halt_speed_tolerance"
def pHeadingSinceStepCarlaSceneGraph : Term := .param "p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph"
def pStopPointTolerance : Term := .param "p.stop_point_tolerance"
def pTurnHeadingMin : Term := .param "p.turn_heading_min"
def pUTurnHeadingMin : Term := .param "p.u_turn_heading_min"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

/-- s6 (2): "two" complete cycles — the text's literal, a count. -/
def twoCycles : Nat := 2

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Building blocks
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def andAll : List Formula → Formula
  | [] => .tt
  | [φ] => φ
  | φ :: rest => .and φ (andAll rest)

def occ (x r : String) : Formula := .atom "rel_occupies" [.var x, .var r] []
def occS (r : String) : Formula := occ "subject" r

/-- Onset: the subject's footprint comes to overlap i. -/
def entryI : Formula := .rises (occS "i")
/-- Recognition: the subject's footprint ceases to overlap i. -/
def exitI : Formula := .rises (.not (occS "i"))

def leftTurn : Formula :=
  .derived "drv_motion_left_turn_through_region" [vSubject, .var "i"]
    [pHeadingSinceStepCarlaSceneGraph, pTurnHeadingMin, pUTurnHeadingMin]
def rightTurn : Formula :=
  .derived "drv_motion_right_turn_through_region" [vSubject, .var "i"]
    [pHeadingSinceStepCarlaSceneGraph, pTurnHeadingMin, pUTurnHeadingMin]
def uTurn : Formula :=
  .derived "drv_motion_u_turn_through_region" [vSubject, .var "i"]
    [pHeadingSinceStepCarlaSceneGraph, pUTurnHeadingMin]

/-- The passage is not a turn in the arrow's direction. -/
def notArrowTurn (dir : String) : Formula :=
  if dir == "left" then .not leftTurn else .not rightTurn

def governs (d r : String) : Formula := .atom "dev_governs" [.var d, .var r] []
def shows (ind : String) : Formula := .atom "dev_traffic_signal_shows" [.var "d", .lit ind] []
def red : Formula := shows "circular_red"
def green : Formula := shows "circular_green"
def arrow (dir : String) : Formula := shows s!"green_arrow({dir})"

/-- s3: the carrier c the subject occupies runs into i. -/
def carrierSel : Formula :=
  .and (occS "c") (.atom "st_lane_enters" [.var "c", .var "i"] [])
/-- s1 + s3: the head d governs c or i and shows steady red with the green arrow, no green. -/
def headSel (dir : String) : Formula :=
  andAll [.or (governs "d" "c") (governs "d" "i"), red, arrow dir, .not green]

/-- s1 + s3 at the entry: some such carrier and head. -/
def selAt (dir : String) : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "c"
    (.and carrierSel (.existsDevice (.lit "traffic_signal") "d" (headSel dir)))

/-- The duty for every carrier and head of the same selection. -/
def forSel (dir : String) (body : Formula) : Formula :=
  .forallRegion (.lit "travel_region") "c"
    (.forallDevice (.lit "traffic_signal") "d"
      (.implies (.and carrierSel (headSel dir)) body))

/-- s1 + s3 + s4 at the exit: the latest entry had the selection, and the passage is straight
    through or opposite the arrow. -/
def occasionAt (dir : String) : Formula :=
  andAll [notArrowTurn dir, .not uTurn, .since (.not entryI) (.and entryI (selAt dir))]

-- (1) Halt and the place of the wait ------------------------------------------------------------
def halted : Formula := .derived "drv_motion_complete_halt" [vSubject] [pHaltSpeedTolerance]
def distTo (r : String) : Term := .measure "st_region_geometry_distance" [vSubject, .var r]
def offsetAlong (r : String) : Term := .quantity "prim_region_offset_along" [vSubject, .var r, .var "c"] []
def marks (m : String) : Formula := .atom "st_entrance_of" [.var m, .var "c"] []

/-- At the mark: within the tolerance, short of it along c, not on it nor in i. -/
def nearMark (m : String) : Formula :=
  andAll [.cmp (distTo m) .le pStopPointTolerance, .cmp (offsetAlong m) .gt zeroMetres,
          .not (occS m), .not (occS "i")]
/-- Approach start for a mark: on c, off the mark, short of it and farther than the tolerance. -/
def approachStartMark (m : String) : Formula :=
  andAll [occS "c", .not (occS m), .cmp (offsetAlong m) .gt zeroMetres,
          .cmp (distTo m) .gt pStopPointTolerance]
/-- At i's edge at c's entrance end, not in i. -/
def nearEdge : Formula :=
  andAll [.cmp (distTo "i") .le pStopPointTolerance, .cmp (offsetAlong "i") .gt zeroMetres, .not (occS "i")]
def approachStartEdge : Formula :=
  andAll [occS "c", .not (occS "i"), .cmp (offsetAlong "i") .gt zeroMetres,
          .cmp (distTo "i") .gt pStopPointTolerance]

/-- The marks' lists are observed and none marks c. -/
def noMark : Formula :=
  .and (.forallRegion (.lit "stop_line") "m" (.not (marks "m")))
       (.forallRegion (.lit "crosswalk") "m" (.not (marks "m")))

/-- The place: at a mark of c, or at i's edge where no mark marks c. -/
def atPlace : Formula :=
  .or (.existsRegion (.lit "stop_line") "m" (.and (marks "m") (nearMark "m")))
    (.or (.existsRegion (.lit "crosswalk") "m" (.and (marks "m") (nearMark "m")))
         (.and noMark nearEdge))

/-- (1) at the entry: a halt at the place, searched back to the approach start or the previous
    passage through i. -/
def haltBefore (kind : String) : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit kind) "m"
    (.and (marks "m")
      (.since (.not (.or (approachStartMark "m") exitI)) (.and halted (nearMark "m"))))
def haltDuty : Formula :=
  .or (haltBefore "stop_line")
    (.or (haltBefore "crosswalk")
      (.and noMark (.since (.not (.or approachStartEdge exitI)) (.and halted nearEdge))))

-- (2) + (3) Wait ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def atRestThere : Formula := .and halted atPlace
def display (dir : String) : Formula := .and red (arrow dir)

/-- At the entry: in the latest run at rest at the place since the previous passage, the display
    rose at least twice, and the head never showed circular_green in that run. -/
def waitDuty (dir : String) : Formula :=
  .since
    (andAll [.not exitI, .not (.rises atRestThere), .implies atRestThere (.not green)])
    (andAll [atRestThere,
             .count (display dir) atRestThere .ge twoCycles,
             .since (.and atRestThere (.not green)) (.and (.rises atRestThere) (.not green))])

-- (4) Another device prohibiting the turn ------------------------------------------------------
def noSign (code : String) : Formula :=
  .not (.existsDevice (.lit "regulatory_sign") "g"
    (.and (.atom "dev_regulatory_sign_code" [.var "g", .lit code] [])
          (.or (governs "g" "c") (governs "g" "i"))))

-- (5) Yield --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def moving : Formula := .cmp (.measure "kin_speed" [vSubject]) .gt pHaltSpeedTolerance
def pedTarget : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [.var "u", .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian"] [])
    (.existsRegion (.lit "crosswalk") "w"
      (.and (occ "u" "w")
        (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "a"
          (.and (.atom "st_entrance_of" [.var "w", .var "a"] [])
                (.atom "st_lane_enters" [.var "a", .var "i"] [])))))
def trafficTarget : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [.var "u", .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic"] []) (occ "u" "i")
def conflict : Formula :=
  .or (.and (.derived "prim_closest_approach_within" [vSubject, .var "u"] [pConflictHorizon])
            (.cmp (.quantity "prim_closest_approach_distance" [vSubject, .var "u"] [pConflictHorizon])
                  .lt pConflictCentreClearance))
      (.atom "rel_contact" [vSubject, .var "u"] [])
def yieldsHere : Formula :=
  .implies moving
    (.forallUser "u"
      (.implies (.and (.not (.same vSubject (.var "u"))) (.or pedTarget trafficTarget))
        (.not conflict)))

/-- Every duty, for the arrow direction `dir`, judged at the exit. -/
def duties (dir : String) : Formula :=
  andAll
    [ .since (.not entryI) (.and entryI (forSel dir (.and haltDuty (waitDuty dir))))
    , .implies rightTurn (.since (.not entryI) (.and entryI (forSel dir (noSign "no_right_turn"))))
    , .implies leftTurn (.since (.not entryI) (.and entryI (forSel dir (noSign "no_left_turn"))))
    , .since (.and (.not entryI) yieldsHere) (.and entryI yieldsHere) ]

  .or (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-135::motorcycle"] [])
    (.or (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-125::moped"] [])
      (.or (.atom "ru_motorcycle" [vSubject] [])
        (.or (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle"] [])
          (.or (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-NRS-484B-017::electric_bicycle"] [])

  .forallRegion (.lit "intersection") "i"
    (.and (.implies (.and exitI (occasionAt "left")) (duties "left"))
          (.implies (.and exitI (occasionAt "right")) (duties "right")))

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
  Metric windows without a frame rate.

  Every observation carries a timestamp; a body also carries the path length it has travelled.
  A window is measured in one of the two: a duration of time, or a length of path travelled.
  Semantics are defined on the OBSERVED instants only; the one interpolation-free precondition is
  adequacy: a window of length d over a span is adequate when consecutive observations in the
  span are at most d/2 apart. An inadequate span yields `unknown`
  with the reason `samplingGap`, never a verdict invented between frames.

  Windows are computed for every instant of a trace at once: positions are monotone, so the
  window boundary moves one way and a two-pointer sweep with a range-maximum table over the gaps
  gives every window in O(n log n).

  There is no `next`, no rate and no frame count anywhere in the library.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units

namespace TrafficSpec

/-- Milliseconds, monotone within a trace. -/
abbrev Timestamp := Int

/-- Which quantity a window is measured in. -/
inductive Measure
  | time | path
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited

/-- A window: a non-negative length in seconds (time) or metres (path). -/
structure Duration where
  measure : Measure
  length : Q
  deriving Repr

namespace Duration
def time (q : Q) : Duration := ⟨.time, q⟩
def path (q : Q) : Duration := ⟨.path, q⟩
end Duration

/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_307_9b.

  Geometry (metres, +x east, +y north). Intersection i (10): the square x −10…10, y −10…10.
  Approach lane c (11): x 0…4, y −60…−10, direction north, entering i. Stop line (12): x 0…4,
  y −11…−10.5, recorded as marking c. Opposite approach lane (13): x −4…0, y 10…60, direction
  south, entering i; north crosswalk (14): x −10…10, y 11…14, recorded as marking lane 13.
  Branch scenes add a south crosswalk (16, y −14…−11, marking c) or remove the marks, or add a
  second northbound approach lane c2 (15, x 4…8) governed by its own head (31, circular_green).
  The head (30) governs c and shows the display of each scene; a regulatory sign (32) governs c or i.

  The motorcycle (track 1; half-extents 1 × 0.4 m) rides at x = 2 heading north. Every scene is
  sampled at 50 ms (the step bound of the turn concepts), so the integration of the yaw rate
  (observed, zero when straight) is defined across the passage. Occupancy is stated from the body
  rectangle (a body across c and i at its entry overlaps both).
  Halting scenes: approach at 4 m/s from 5 m behind the halt point (the first frames are the
  approach start: the body is more than 2 m short of the mark), at rest from frame 25 to 45 with
  its front 1.25 m short of the mark, then 10 m/s: entry at frame 50, straight exit at frame 94.
  Non-halting scenes: 10 m/s from y = −25. Display cycles: red alone, then red with the arrow from
  frame 30, red alone from 35, red with the arrow from 40 (two rises during the wait); the forbid
  display rises once (frame 30).
  Each witness speaks about the instants from 50 ms on: the first observation has no previous one,
  so its entries and exits are not decided.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_307_9b
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_307_9b

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mm (n : Int) : Q := Units.millimetres n
def qk (k : Nat) : Q := Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy from body rectangles
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Box where
  x0 : Q
  y0 : Q
  x1 : Q
  y1 : Q

def overlaps (a b : Box) : Bool :=
  Q.lt a.x0 b.x1 && Q.lt b.x0 a.x1 && Q.lt a.y0 b.y1 && Q.lt b.y0 a.y1

def bbox (poly : List Vec) : Box :=
  match poly with
  | [] => ⟨Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero⟩
  | p :: ps => ps.foldl (fun b q => ⟨Q.min b.x0 q.1, Q.min b.y0 q.2, Q.max b.x1 q.1, Q.max b.y1 q.2⟩)
      ⟨p.1, p.2, p.1, p.2⟩

/-- The body rectangle of a user heading along an axis. -/
def userBox (u : RoadUser) : Option Box := do
  let p ← u.kin.position
  let h ← u.kin.heading
  let (hl, hw, _) ← u.kin.extent
  let ax := if Q.isZero h.1 then hw else hl
  let ay := if Q.isZero h.1 then hl else hw
  pure ⟨Q.sub p.1 ax, Q.sub p.2 ay, Q.add p.1 ax, Q.add p.2 ay⟩

def occupancy (users : List RoadUser) (structs : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match userBox u with
    | none => []
    | some b => structs.filterMap fun st =>
        match st.boundary with
        | some poly => if overlaps b (bbox poly) then some (u.track, st.id) else none
        | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Structures and devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rectPts (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : List Vec := [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

def interS : Structure := Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 10)
def laneC : Structure := Build.lane 11 (rectPts (m 0) (m (-60)) (m 4) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def stopLineS : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 12 .stopLine (m 0) (m (-11)) (m 4) (cm (-1050)) with entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true }
def laneOpp : Structure := Build.lane 13 (rectPts (m (-4)) (m 10) (m 0) (m 60)) Build.south (enters := some 10)
def cwNorth : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 14 .crosswalk (m (-10)) (m 11) (m 10) (m 14) with
    entranceOf := [13], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }
def laneC2 : Structure := Build.lane 15 (rectPts (m 4) (m (-60)) (m 8) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def cwSouth : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 16 .crosswalk (m (-10)) (m (-14)) (m 10) (m (-11)) with
    entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }

def baseStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, stopLineS, laneOpp, cwNorth]
def noMarkStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, laneOpp, cwNorth]

def head2 : Device := Build.signal 31 [15] [.circularGreen]
def turnSign (code : SignCode) (gov : List RegionId) : Device :=
  { Build.sign 32 .regulatorySign gov with code := some code, conditions := some {} }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Displays
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def steady (dir : ArrowDir) : List SignalIndication := [.circularRed, .greenArrow dir]
/-- Two rises of red-with-arrow during the wait (frames 30 and 40). -/
def dispCycles (dir : ArrowDir) (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady dir
  else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady dir
/-- One rise only (frame 30). -/
def dispOnce (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else steady .left
/-- Two rises, but circular_green for frames 35–37 of the wait. -/
def dispGreenInWait (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady .left
  else if k < 38 then [.circularGreen] else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady .left

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Motion profiles: distance travelled and speed by frame
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def profHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ kh then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk k)
  else if k ≤ kg then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)
  else Q.add (Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - kg)))
def speedHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < kh then Units.metresPerSecond 4 else if k ≤ kg then Q.zero else Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profConst (k : Nat) : Q := Q.mul (cm 50) (qk k)
def speedConst (_k : Nat) : Q := Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ ks then Q.mul (mm 25) (qk k) else Q.add (Q.mul (mm 25) (qk ks)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - ks)))
def speedSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < ks then cm 50 else Units.metresPerSecond 10

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A scene configuration
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Cfg where
  n : Nat := 100
  yStart : Q
  dist : Nat → Q
  speed : Nat → Q
  /-- 0 straight, 1 left, −1 right; the turn is made at `yTurn`, the yaw rate set over frames
      `yawFrom`…`yawTo` (±90 deg/s, 20 frames: ±90 degrees). -/
  turn : Int := 0
  yTurn : Q := cm (-575)
  yawFrom : Nat := 56
  yawTo : Nat := 75
  /-- Lane change to x = 6 (lane c2) once the reference point reaches this y. -/
  xShiftY : Option Q := none
  display : Nat → List SignalIndication
  headGov : List RegionId := [11]
  withHead2 : Bool := false
  sign : Option Device := none
  structs : List Structure := baseStructs
  others : Nat → List RoadUser := fun _ => []

def subjectAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let d := c.dist k
  let y := Q.add c.yStart d
  let dTurn := Q.sub c.yTurn c.yStart
  let x0 : Q := match c.xShiftY with
    | some ys => if Q.le ys y then m 6 else m 2
    | none => m 2
  let straight := c.turn == 0 || Q.le d dTurn
  let pos : Vec :=
    if straight then (x0, y)
    else if c.turn > 0 then (Q.sub x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
    else (Q.add x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
  let hd : Vec := if straight then Build.north else if c.turn > 0 then Build.west else Build.east
  let yaw : Q :=
    if c.turn != 0 && c.yawFrom ≤ k && k ≤ c.yawTo then
      (if c.turn > 0 then Units.degrees 90 else Units.degrees (-90))
    else Q.zero
  Build.withKin (Build.user 1 [.motorcycle] pos hd (c.speed k) (m 1, cm 40, cm 70))
    fun kin => { kin with yawRate := some yaw }

def sceneAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) (t : Timestamp) : Scene :=
  let users := subjectAt c k :: c.others k
  let devs := [Build.signal 30 c.headGov (c.display k)] ++ (if c.withHead2 then [head2] else []) ++ c.sign.toList
  Build.scene t (some 1) users c.structs devs (occupies := some (occupancy users c.structs))

def traceOf (c : Cfg) : Trace := Build.trace c.n 0 (Units.milliseconds 50) (sceneAt c)
def windowOf (c : Cfg) : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := some (50, Int.ofNat ((c.n - 1) * 50))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Other road users
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def ped (pos : Vec) (hd : Vec) (v : Q) : RoadUser := Build.user 2 [.pedestrian] pos hd v (cm 30, cm 30, cm 90)
def car (x : Q) : RoadUser := Build.user 3 [.motorVehicle] (x, m 3) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 8) (cm 225, m 1, cm 75)

/-- Standing in the north crosswalk (marking the opposite lane), 2 m left of the motorcycle's line. -/
def pedStanding (_k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [ped (m 0, cm 1250) Build.west Q.zero]
/-- North of the crosswalk until frame 50, then walking south at 1.5 m/s into it (from frame 67),
    1.5 m right of the motorcycle's line. -/
def pedCrossing (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  if k ≤ 50 then [ped (cm 350, cm 1550) Build.south Q.zero]
  else [ped (cm 350, Q.sub (cm 1550) (Q.mul (mm 75) (qk (k - 50)))) Build.south (cm 150)]
/-- In the north crosswalk at the start, walking west at 1.5 m/s; off it from frame 35. -/
def pedLeaving (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  [ped (Q.sub (m (-8)) (Q.mul (mm 75) (qk k)), cm 1250) Build.west (cm 150)]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, 8 m/s, entering i at frame 51 on a course whose centre miss distance with
    the motorcycle is 2.7 m. -/
def carConflict (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (cm (-1250)) (Q.mul (cm 40) (Q.sub (qk k) (qk 50))))]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, out of i from frame 44. -/
def carGone (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (m (-5)) (Q.mul (cm 40) (qk k)))]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, already past the motorcycle's line at its entry and moving away; in i until frame 70. -/
def carAhead (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (m 4) (Q.mul (cm 40) (Q.sub (qk k) (qk 50))))]

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Configurations
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def permitCfg : Cfg :=
  { yStart := cm (-1825), dist := profHalt 25 45, speed := speedHalt 25 45, display := dispCycles .left }
def forbidCfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with display := dispOnce }
def runCfg : Cfg :=
  { yStart := m (-25), dist := profConst, speed := speedConst, display := fun _ => steady .left }

/-- `forbid` (violated): A motorcycle (ru.aggregate motorcycle) occupies approach lane c entering i, with a stop line recorded as marking c; the head governing c displays circular_red with green_arrow(left). The motorcycle halts at the stop line, waits while the red-with-arrow display comes on again once only, then enters i and exits straight ahead (no turn concept holds). No pedestrian or other road user is present. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace := traceOf forbidCfg

/-- `permit` (compliant): As in forbid, but the motorcycle remains at rest at the stop line while the red-with-arrow display rises twice, the head never displays circular_green, and it then proceeds straight through i. No other road user is in the scene, so the yield is decided on the subject alone. -/
def permitTrace : Trace := traceOf permitCfg

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The head governing c displays circular_green at the motorcycle's entry; it proceeds straight through. -/
def idleCfg : Cfg := { runCfg with display := fun _ => [.circularGreen] }
def idleTrace : Trace := traceOf idleCfg

/-- `blind` (unknown): As in forbid, but the state of the head governing c is never observed (dev.traffic_signal absent). -/
def blindTrace : Trace := traceOf forbidCfg

/-- `history_boundary` (unknown): The recording begins with the motorcycle already within the stop line's stopping zone on c, moving slowly, under red with green_arrow(left); it enters i and exits straight. No halt is recorded, the approach start and any earlier wait lie before the recording, and no earlier entry into i is recorded. -/
def historyCfg : Cfg :=
  { yStart := cm (-1325), dist := profSlow 20, speed := speedSlow 20, display := fun _ => steady .left }
def history_boundaryTrace : Trace := traceOf historyCfg

/-- `branch_1` (violated): As in permit, but the motorcycle turns right (opposite the left arrow; drv.motion.right_turn_through_region at the exit) while a dev.regulatory_sign with code no_right_turn governs c. -/
def branch1Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with turn := -1, sign := some (turnSign .noRightTurn [11]) }
def branch_1Trace : Trace := traceOf branch1Cfg

/-- `branch_2` (violated): As in permit, but a pedestrian occupies the crosswalk recorded as marking the entrance of the opposite carrier; the moving motorcycle's closest approach to it lies within the horizon at a centre distance below the clearance. -/
def branch2Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := pedStanding }
def branch_2Trace : Trace := traceOf branch2Cfg

/-- `branch_3` (compliant): As in permit, but a car crossing i eastbound is already past the
    motorcycle's line at its entry and moving away: no closest approach ahead below the clearance,
    no contact. -/

/-

  Geometry (metres, +x east, +y north). Intersection i (10): the square x −10…10, y −10…10.

  y −11…−10.5, recorded as marking c. Opposite approach lane (13): x −4…0, y 10…60, direction
  south, entering i; north crosswalk (14): x −10…10, y 11…14, recorded as marking lane 13.
  Branch scenes add a south crosswalk (16, y −14…−11, marking c) or remove the marks, or add a
  second northbound approach lane c2 (15, x 4…8) governed by its own head (31, circular_green).

  sampled at 50 ms (the step bound of the turn concepts), so the integration of the yaw rate
  (observed, zero when straight) is defined across the passage. Occupancy is stated from the body
  rectangle (a body across c and i at its entry overlaps both).
  Halting scenes: approach at 4 m/s from 5 m behind the halt point (the first frames are the
  approach start: the body is more than 2 m short of the mark), at rest from frame 25 to 45 with
  its front 1.25 m short of the mark, then 10 m/s: entry at frame 50, straight exit at frame 94.
  Non-halting scenes: 10 m/s from y = −25. Display cycles: red alone, then red with the arrow from
  frame 30, red alone from 35, red with the arrow from 40 (two rises during the wait); the forbid
  display rises once (frame 30).

  so its entries and exits are not decided.

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_307_9b

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mm (n : Int) : Q := Units.millimetres n
def qk (k : Nat) : Q := Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy from body rectangles
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Box where
  x0 : Q
  y0 : Q
  x1 : Q
  y1 : Q

def overlaps (a b : Box) : Bool :=
  Q.lt a.x0 b.x1 && Q.lt b.x0 a.x1 && Q.lt a.y0 b.y1 && Q.lt b.y0 a.y1

def bbox (poly : List Vec) : Box :=
  match poly with
  | [] => ⟨Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero⟩
  | p :: ps => ps.foldl (fun b q => ⟨Q.min b.x0 q.1, Q.min b.y0 q.2, Q.max b.x1 q.1, Q.max b.y1 q.2⟩)
      ⟨p.1, p.2, p.1, p.2⟩

/-- The body rectangle of a user heading along an axis. -/
def userBox (u : RoadUser) : Option Box := do
  let p ← u.kin.position
  let h ← u.kin.heading
  let (hl, hw, _) ← u.kin.extent
  let ax := if Q.isZero h.1 then hw else hl
  let ay := if Q.isZero h.1 then hl else hw
  pure ⟨Q.sub p.1 ax, Q.sub p.2 ay, Q.add p.1 ax, Q.add p.2 ay⟩

def occupancy (users : List RoadUser) (structs : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match userBox u with
    | none => []
    | some b => structs.filterMap fun st =>
        match st.boundary with
        | some poly => if overlaps b (bbox poly) then some (u.track, st.id) else none
        | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Structures and devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rectPts (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : List Vec := [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

def interS : Structure := Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 10)
def laneC : Structure := Build.lane 11 (rectPts (m 0) (m (-60)) (m 4) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def stopLineS : Structure :=

def laneOpp : Structure := Build.lane 13 (rectPts (m (-4)) (m 10) (m 0) (m 60)) Build.south (enters := some 10)
def cwNorth : Structure :=

    entranceOf := [13], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }
def laneC2 : Structure := Build.lane 15 (rectPts (m 4) (m (-60)) (m 8) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def cwSouth : Structure :=

    entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }

def profHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=

  let y := Q.add c.yStart d
  let dTurn := Q.sub c.yTurn c.yStart
  let x0 : Q := match c.xShiftY with
    | some ys => if Q.le ys y then m 6 else m 2
    | none => m 2
  let straight := c.turn == 0 || Q.le d dTurn

    else if c.turn > 0 then (Q.sub x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
    else (Q.add x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
  let hd : Vec := if straight then Build.north else if c.turn > 0 then Build.west else Build.east

    else Q.zero

import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_307_9b
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_307_9b

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mm (n : Int) : Q := Units.millimetres n
def qk (k : Nat) : Q := Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy from body rectangles
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Box where
  x0 : Q
  y0 : Q
  x1 : Q
  y1 : Q

def overlaps (a b : Box) : Bool :=
  Q.lt a.x0 b.x1 && Q.lt b.x0 a.x1 && Q.lt a.y0 b.y1 && Q.lt b.y0 a.y1

def bbox (poly : List Vec) : Box :=
  match poly with
  | [] => ⟨Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero⟩
  | p :: ps => ps.foldl (fun b q => ⟨Q.min b.x0 q.1, Q.min b.y0 q.2, Q.max b.x1 q.1, Q.max b.y1 q.2⟩)
      ⟨p.1, p.2, p.1, p.2⟩

/-- The body rectangle of a user heading along an axis. -/
def userBox (u : RoadUser) : Option Box := do
  let p ← u.kin.position
  let h ← u.kin.heading
  let (hl, hw, _) ← u.kin.extent
  let ax := if Q.isZero h.1 then hw else hl
  let ay := if Q.isZero h.1 then hl else hw
  pure ⟨Q.sub p.1 ax, Q.sub p.2 ay, Q.add p.1 ax, Q.add p.2 ay⟩

def occupancy (users : List RoadUser) (structs : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match userBox u with
    | none => []
    | some b => structs.filterMap fun st =>
        match st.boundary with
        | some poly => if overlaps b (bbox poly) then some (u.track, st.id) else none
        | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Structures and devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rectPts (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : List Vec := [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

def interS : Structure := Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 10)
def laneC : Structure := Build.lane 11 (rectPts (m 0) (m (-60)) (m 4) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def stopLineS : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 12 .stopLine (m 0) (m (-11)) (m 4) (cm (-1050)) with entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true }
def laneOpp : Structure := Build.lane 13 (rectPts (m (-4)) (m 10) (m 0) (m 60)) Build.south (enters := some 10)
def cwNorth : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 14 .crosswalk (m (-10)) (m 11) (m 10) (m 14) with
    entranceOf := [13], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }
def laneC2 : Structure := Build.lane 15 (rectPts (m 4) (m (-60)) (m 8) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def cwSouth : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 16 .crosswalk (m (-10)) (m (-14)) (m 10) (m (-11)) with
    entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }

def baseStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, stopLineS, laneOpp, cwNorth]
def noMarkStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, laneOpp, cwNorth]

def head2 : Device := Build.signal 31 [15] [.circularGreen]
def turnSign (code : SignCode) (gov : List RegionId) : Device :=
  { Build.sign 32 .regulatorySign gov with code := some code, conditions := some {} }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Displays
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def steady (dir : ArrowDir) : List SignalIndication := [.circularRed, .greenArrow dir]
/-- Two rises of red-with-arrow during the wait (frames 30 and 40). -/
def dispCycles (dir : ArrowDir) (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady dir
  else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady dir
/-- One rise only (frame 30). -/
def dispOnce (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else steady .left
/-- Two rises, but circular_green for frames 35–37 of the wait. -/
def dispGreenInWait (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady .left
  else if k < 38 then [.circularGreen] else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady .left

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Motion profiles: distance travelled and speed by frame
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def profHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ kh then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk k)
  else if k ≤ kg then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)
  else Q.add (Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - kg)))
def speedHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < kh then Units.metresPerSecond 4 else if k ≤ kg then Q.zero else Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profConst (k : Nat) : Q := Q.mul (cm 50) (qk k)
def speedConst (_k : Nat) : Q := Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ ks then Q.mul (mm 25) (qk k) else Q.add (Q.mul (mm 25) (qk ks)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - ks)))
def speedSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < ks then cm 50 else Units.metresPerSecond 10

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A scene configuration
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Cfg where
  n : Nat := 100
  yStart : Q
  dist : Nat → Q
  speed : Nat → Q
  /-- 0 straight, 1 left, −1 right; the turn is made at `yTurn`, the yaw rate set over frames
      `yawFrom`…`yawTo` (±90 deg/s, 20 frames: ±90 degrees). -/
  turn : Int := 0
  yTurn : Q := cm (-575)
  yawFrom : Nat := 56
  yawTo : Nat := 75
  /-- Lane change to x = 6 (lane c2) once the reference point reaches this y. -/
  xShiftY : Option Q := none
  display : Nat → List SignalIndication
  headGov : List RegionId := [11]
  withHead2 : Bool := false
  sign : Option Device := none
  structs : List Structure := baseStructs
  others : Nat → List RoadUser := fun _ => []

def subjectAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let d := c.dist k
  let y := Q.add c.yStart d
  let dTurn := Q.sub c.yTurn c.yStart
  let x0 : Q := match c.xShiftY with
    | some ys => if Q.le ys y then m 6 else m 2
    | none => m 2
  let straight := c.turn == 0 || Q.le d dTurn
  let pos : Vec :=
    if straight then (x0, y)
    else if c.turn > 0 then (Q.sub x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
    else (Q.add x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
  let hd : Vec := if straight then Build.north else if c.turn > 0 then Build.west else Build.east
  let yaw : Q :=
    if c.turn != 0 && c.yawFrom ≤ k && k ≤ c.yawTo then
      (if c.turn > 0 then Units.degrees 90 else Units.degrees (-90))
    else Q.zero
  Build.withKin (Build.user 1 [.motorcycle] pos hd (c.speed k) (m 1, cm 40, cm 70))
    fun kin => { kin with yawRate := some yaw }

def sceneAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) (t : Timestamp) : Scene :=
  let users := subjectAt c k :: c.others k
  let devs := [Build.signal 30 c.headGov (c.display k)] ++ (if c.withHead2 then [head2] else []) ++ c.sign.toList
  Build.scene t (some 1) users c.structs devs (occupies := some (occupancy users c.structs))

def traceOf (c : Cfg) : Trace := Build.trace c.n 0 (Units.milliseconds 50) (sceneAt c)
def windowOf (c : Cfg) : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := some (50, Int.ofNat ((c.n - 1) * 50))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Other road users
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def ped (pos : Vec) (hd : Vec) (v : Q) : RoadUser := Build.user 2 [.pedestrian] pos hd v (cm 30, cm 30, cm 90)
def car (x : Q) : RoadUser := Build.user 3 [.motorVehicle] (x, m 3) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 8) (cm 225, m 1, cm 75)

/-- Standing in the north crosswalk (marking the opposite lane), 2 m left of the motorcycle's line. -/
def pedStanding (_k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [ped (m 0, cm 1250) Build.west Q.zero]
/-- North of the crosswalk until frame 50, then walking south at 1.5 m/s into it (from frame 67),
    1.5 m right of the motorcycle's line. -/
def pedCrossing (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  if k ≤ 50 then [ped (cm 350, cm 1550) Build.south Q.zero]
  else [ped (cm 350, Q.sub (cm 1550) (Q.mul (mm 75) (qk (k - 50)))) Build.south (cm 150)]
/-- In the north crosswalk at the start, walking west at 1.5 m/s; off it from frame 35. -/
def pedLeaving (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  [ped (Q.sub (m (-8)) (Q.mul (mm 75) (qk k)), cm 1250) Build.west (cm 150)]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, 8 m/s, entering i at frame 51 on a course whose centre miss distance with
    the motorcycle is 2.7 m. -/
def carConflict (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (cm (-1250)) (Q.mul (cm 40) (Q.sub (qk k) (qk 50))))]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, out of i from frame 44. -/
def carGone (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (m (-5)) (Q.mul (cm 40) (qk k)))]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, already past the motorcycle's line at its entry and moving away; in i until frame 70. -/
def carAhead (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (m 4) (Q.mul (cm 40) (Q.sub (qk k) (qk 50))))]

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Configurations
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def permitCfg : Cfg :=
  { yStart := cm (-1825), dist := profHalt 25 45, speed := speedHalt 25 45, display := dispCycles .left }
def forbidCfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with display := dispOnce }
def runCfg : Cfg :=
  { yStart := m (-25), dist := profConst, speed := speedConst, display := fun _ => steady .left }

/-- `forbid` (violated): A motorcycle (ru.aggregate motorcycle) occupies approach lane c entering i, with a stop line recorded as marking c; the head governing c displays circular_red with green_arrow(left). The motorcycle halts at the stop line, waits while the red-with-arrow display comes on again once only, then enters i and exits straight ahead (no turn concept holds). No pedestrian or other road user is present. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace := traceOf forbidCfg

/-- `permit` (compliant): As in forbid, but the motorcycle remains at rest at the stop line while the red-with-arrow display rises twice, the head never displays circular_green, and it then proceeds straight through i. No other road user is in the scene, so the yield is decided on the subject alone. -/
def permitTrace : Trace := traceOf permitCfg

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The head governing c displays circular_green at the motorcycle's entry; it proceeds straight through. -/
def idleCfg : Cfg := { runCfg with display := fun _ => [.circularGreen] }
def idleTrace : Trace := traceOf idleCfg

/-- `blind` (unknown): As in forbid, but the state of the head governing c is never observed (dev.traffic_signal absent). -/
def blindTrace : Trace := traceOf forbidCfg

/-- `history_boundary` (unknown): The recording begins with the motorcycle already within the stop line's stopping zone on c, moving slowly, under red with green_arrow(left); it enters i and exits straight. No halt is recorded, the approach start and any earlier wait lie before the recording, and no earlier entry into i is recorded. -/
def historyCfg : Cfg :=
  { yStart := cm (-1325), dist := profSlow 20, speed := speedSlow 20, display := fun _ => steady .left }
def history_boundaryTrace : Trace := traceOf historyCfg

/-- `branch_1` (violated): As in permit, but the motorcycle turns right (opposite the left arrow; drv.motion.right_turn_through_region at the exit) while a dev.regulatory_sign with code no_right_turn governs c. -/
def branch1Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with turn := -1, sign := some (turnSign .noRightTurn [11]) }
def branch_1Trace : Trace := traceOf branch1Cfg

def branch2Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := pedStanding }

    no contact. -/
def branch3Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := carAhead }

    two cycles, turns left (opposite the arrow) while a no_left_turn sign governs i. -/
def branch4Cfg : Cfg :=

/-- `branch_5` (violated): As in permit, but the head shows circular_green for part of the wait (the

/-- `branch_7` (compliant): No stop line or crosswalk marks c (the crosswalk present marks the

def occS1OutCfg : Cfg := { runCfg with display := fun k => if k < 20 then steady .left else [.circularGreen] }
def occasion_s1_outsideTrace : Trace := traceOf occS1OutCfg

def occasion_s3Trace : Trace := traceOf runCfg

def occS3OutCfg : Cfg :=

def occasion_s3_outsideTrace : Trace := traceOf occS3OutCfg

def occasion_s8Trace : Trace := traceOf occS8Cfg

def occS8OutCfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := pedLeaving }
def occasion_s8_outsideTrace : Trace := traceOf occS8OutCfg

/-- `occasion_s9` (violated): As in permit, but for part of the passage another car occupies i on a converging course; the moving motorcycle's closest approach to it lies within the horizon below the clearance. -/
def occS9Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := carConflict }
def occasion_s9Trace : Trace := traceOf occS9Cfg

/-- `occasion_s9_outside` (compliant): As in permit, but another car occupied i only before the motorcycle's entry and left it before the entry. -/
def occS9OutCfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := carGone }
def occasion_s9_outsideTrace : Trace := traceOf occS9OutCfg

    rule := "NRS_484B_307_9b"

    grounding := [("subject", 1)]
    expected := expected

  , witness "idle" idleCfg .notApplicable
  , witness "blind" forbidCfg (.unknown []) ["dev.traffic_signal"]
  , witness "history_boundary" historyCfg (.unknown []) (boundary := "the motorcycle's approach to the stop line on c and any run at rest there before the recording began")

  , witness "branch_4" branch4Cfg .violated
  , witness "branch_5" branch5Cfg .violated
  , witness "branch_6" branch6Cfg .compliant
  , witness "branch_7" branch7Cfg .compliant
  , witness "branch_8" branch8Cfg .violated
  , witness "occasion_s1" occS1Cfg .violated

  , witness "occasion_s3" runCfg .violated
  , witness "occasion_s3_outside" occS3OutCfg .notApplicable
  , witness "occasion_s8" occS8Cfg .violated
  , witness "occasion_s8_outside" occS8OutCfg .compliant
  , witness "occasion_s9" occS9Cfg .violated
  , witness "occasion_s9_outside" occS9OutCfg .compliant ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_307_9b

/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_307_9b.

  Geometry (metres, +x east, +y north). Intersection i (10): the square x −10…10, y −10…10.
  Approach lane c (11): x 0…4, y −60…−10, direction north, entering i. Stop line (12): x 0…4,
  y −11…−10.5, recorded as marking c. Opposite approach lane (13): x −4…0, y 10…60, direction
  south, entering i; north crosswalk (14): x −10…10, y 11…14, recorded as marking lane 13.
  Branch scenes add a south crosswalk (16, y −14…−11, marking c) or remove the marks, or add a
  second northbound approach lane c2 (15, x 4…8) governed by its own head (31, circular_green).
  The head (30) governs c and shows the display of each scene; a regulatory sign (32) governs c or i.

  The motorcycle (track 1; half-extents 1 × 0.4 m) rides at x = 2 heading north. Every scene is
  sampled at 50 ms (the step bound of the turn concepts), so the integration of the yaw rate
  (observed, zero when straight) is defined across the passage. Occupancy is stated from the body
  rectangle (a body across c and i at its entry overlaps both).
  Halting scenes: approach at 4 m/s from 5 m behind the halt point (the first frames are the
  approach start: the body is more than 2 m short of the mark), at rest from frame 25 to 45 with
  its front 1.25 m short of the mark, then 10 m/s: entry at frame 50, straight exit at frame 94.
  Non-halting scenes: 10 m/s from y = −25. Display cycles: red alone, then red with the arrow from
  frame 30, red alone from 35, red with the arrow from 40 (two rises during the wait); the forbid
  display rises once (frame 30).
  Each witness speaks about the instants from 50 ms on: the first observation has no previous one,
  so its entries and exits are not decided.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_307_9b
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_307_9b

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mm (n : Int) : Q := Units.millimetres n
def qk (k : Nat) : Q := Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy from body rectangles
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Box where
  x0 : Q
  y0 : Q
  x1 : Q
  y1 : Q

def overlaps (a b : Box) : Bool :=
  Q.lt a.x0 b.x1 && Q.lt b.x0 a.x1 && Q.lt a.y0 b.y1 && Q.lt b.y0 a.y1

def bbox (poly : List Vec) : Box :=
  match poly with
  | [] => ⟨Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero⟩
  | p :: ps => ps.foldl (fun b q => ⟨Q.min b.x0 q.1, Q.min b.y0 q.2, Q.max b.x1 q.1, Q.max b.y1 q.2⟩)
      ⟨p.1, p.2, p.1, p.2⟩

/-- The body rectangle of a user heading along an axis. -/
def userBox (u : RoadUser) : Option Box := do
  let p ← u.kin.position
  let h ← u.kin.heading
  let (hl, hw, _) ← u.kin.extent
  let ax := if Q.isZero h.1 then hw else hl
  let ay := if Q.isZero h.1 then hl else hw
  pure ⟨Q.sub p.1 ax, Q.sub p.2 ay, Q.add p.1 ax, Q.add p.2 ay⟩

def occupancy (users : List RoadUser) (structs : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match userBox u with
    | none => []
    | some b => structs.filterMap fun st =>
        match st.boundary with
        | some poly => if overlaps b (bbox poly) then some (u.track, st.id) else none
        | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Structures and devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rectPts (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : List Vec := [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

def interS : Structure := Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 10)
def laneC : Structure := Build.lane 11 (rectPts (m 0) (m (-60)) (m 4) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def stopLineS : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 12 .stopLine (m 0) (m (-11)) (m 4) (cm (-1050)) with entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true }
def laneOpp : Structure := Build.lane 13 (rectPts (m (-4)) (m 10) (m 0) (m 60)) Build.south (enters := some 10)
def cwNorth : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 14 .crosswalk (m (-10)) (m 11) (m 10) (m 14) with
    entranceOf := [13], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }
def laneC2 : Structure := Build.lane 15 (rectPts (m 4) (m (-60)) (m 8) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def cwSouth : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 16 .crosswalk (m (-10)) (m (-14)) (m 10) (m (-11)) with
    entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }

def baseStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, stopLineS, laneOpp, cwNorth]
def noMarkStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, laneOpp, cwNorth]

def head2 : Device := Build.signal 31 [15] [.circularGreen]
def turnSign (code : SignCode) (gov : List RegionId) : Device :=
  { Build.sign 32 .regulatorySign gov with code := some code, conditions := some {} }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Displays
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def steady (dir : ArrowDir) : List SignalIndication := [.circularRed, .greenArrow dir]
/-- Two rises of red-with-arrow during the wait (frames 30 and 40). -/
def dispCycles (dir : ArrowDir) (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady dir
  else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady dir
/-- One rise only (frame 30). -/
def dispOnce (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else steady .left
/-- Two rises, but circular_green for frames 35–37 of the wait. -/
def dispGreenInWait (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady .left
  else if k < 38 then [.circularGreen] else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady .left

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Motion profiles: distance travelled and speed by frame
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def profHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ kh then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk k)
  else if k ≤ kg then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)
  else Q.add (Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - kg)))
def speedHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < kh then Units.metresPerSecond 4 else if k ≤ kg then Q.zero else Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profConst (k : Nat) : Q := Q.mul (cm 50) (qk k)
def speedConst (_k : Nat) : Q := Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ ks then Q.mul (mm 25) (qk k) else Q.add (Q.mul (mm 25) (qk ks)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - ks)))
def speedSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < ks then cm 50 else Units.metresPerSecond 10

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A scene configuration
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Cfg where
  n : Nat := 100
  yStart : Q
  dist : Nat → Q
  speed : Nat → Q
  /-- 0 straight, 1 left, −1 right; the turn is made at `yTurn`, the yaw rate set over frames
      `yawFrom`…`yawTo` (±90 deg/s, 20 frames: ±90 degrees). -/
  turn : Int := 0
  yTurn : Q := cm (-575)
  yawFrom : Nat := 56
  yawTo : Nat := 75
  /-- Lane change to x = 6 (lane c2) once the reference point reaches this y. -/
  xShiftY : Option Q := none
  display : Nat → List SignalIndication
  headGov : List RegionId := [11]
  withHead2 : Bool := false
  sign : Option Device := none
  structs : List Structure := baseStructs
  others : Nat → List RoadUser := fun _ => []

def subjectAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let d := c.dist k
  let y := Q.add c.yStart d
  let dTurn := Q.sub c.yTurn c.yStart
  let x0 : Q := match c.xShiftY with
    | some ys => if Q.le ys y then m 6 else m 2
    | none => m 2
  let straight := c.turn == 0 || Q.le d dTurn
  let pos : Vec :=
    if straight then (x0, y)
    else if c.turn > 0 then (Q.sub x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
    else (Q.add x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
  let hd : Vec := if straight then Build.north else if c.turn > 0 then Build.west else Build.east
  let yaw : Q :=
    if c.turn != 0 && c.yawFrom ≤ k && k ≤ c.yawTo then
      (if c.turn > 0 then Units.degrees 90 else Units.degrees (-90))
    else Q.zero
  Build.withKin (Build.user 1 [.motorcycle] pos hd (c.speed k) (m 1, cm 40, cm 70))
    fun kin => { kin with yawRate := some yaw }

def sceneAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) (t : Timestamp) : Scene :=
  let users := subjectAt c k :: c.others k
  let devs := [Build.signal 30 c.headGov (c.display k)] ++ (if c.withHead2 then [head2] else []) ++ c.sign.toList
  Build.scene t (some 1) users c.structs devs (occupies := some (occupancy users c.structs))

def traceOf (c : Cfg) : Trace := Build.trace c.n 0 (Units.milliseconds 50) (sceneAt c)
def windowOf (c : Cfg) : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := some (50, Int.ofNat ((c.n - 1) * 50))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Other road users
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def ped (pos : Vec) (hd : Vec) (v : Q) : RoadUser := Build.user 2 [.pedestrian] pos hd v (cm 30, cm 30, cm 90)
def car (x : Q) : RoadUser := Build.user 3 [.motorVehicle] (x, m 3) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 8) (cm 225, m 1, cm 75)

/-- Standing in the north crosswalk (marking the opposite lane), 2 m left of the motorcycle's line. -/
def pedStanding (_k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [ped (m 0, cm 1250) Build.west Q.zero]
/-- North of the crosswalk until frame 50, then walking south at 1.5 m/s into it (from frame 67),
    1.5 m right of the motorcycle's line. -/
def pedCrossing (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  if k ≤ 50 then [ped (cm 350, cm 1550) Build.south Q.zero]
  else [ped (cm 350, Q.sub (cm 1550) (Q.mul (mm 75) (qk (k - 50)))) Build.south (cm 150)]
/-- In the north crosswalk at the start, walking west at 1.5 m/s; off it from frame 35. -/
def pedLeaving (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  [ped (Q.sub (m (-8)) (Q.mul (mm 75) (qk k)), cm 1250) Build.west (cm 150)]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, 8 m/s, entering i at frame 51 on a course whose centre miss distance with
    the motorcycle is 2.7 m. -/
def carConflict (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (cm (-1250)) (Q.mul (cm 40) (Q.sub (qk k) (qk 50))))]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, out of i from frame 44. -/
def carGone (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (m (-5)) (Q.mul (cm 40) (qk k)))]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, already past the motorcycle's line at its entry and moving away; in i until frame 70. -/
def carAhead (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (m 4) (Q.mul (cm 40) (Q.sub (qk k) (qk 50))))]

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Configurations
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def permitCfg : Cfg :=
  { yStart := cm (-1825), dist := profHalt 25 45, speed := speedHalt 25 45, display := dispCycles .left }
def forbidCfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with display := dispOnce }
def runCfg : Cfg :=
  { yStart := m (-25), dist := profConst, speed := speedConst, display := fun _ => steady .left }

/-- `forbid` (violated): A motorcycle (ru.aggregate motorcycle) occupies approach lane c entering i, with a stop line recorded as marking c; the head governing c displays circular_red with green_arrow(left). The motorcycle halts at the stop line, waits while the red-with-arrow display comes on again once only, then enters i and exits straight ahead (no turn concept holds). No pedestrian or other road user is present. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace := traceOf forbidCfg

/-- `permit` (compliant): As in forbid, but the motorcycle remains at rest at the stop line while the red-with-arrow display rises twice, the head never displays circular_green, and it then proceeds straight through i. No other road user is in the scene, so the yield is decided on the subject alone. -/
def permitTrace : Trace := traceOf permitCfg

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The head governing c displays circular_green at the motorcycle's entry; it proceeds straight through. -/
def idleCfg : Cfg := { runCfg with display := fun _ => [.circularGreen] }
def idleTrace : Trace := traceOf idleCfg

/-- `blind` (unknown): As in forbid, but the state of the head governing c is never observed (dev.traffic_signal absent). -/
def blindTrace : Trace := traceOf forbidCfg

/-- `history_boundary` (unknown): The recording begins with the motorcycle already within the stop line's stopping zone on c, moving slowly, under red with green_arrow(left); it enters i and exits straight. No halt is recorded, the approach start and any earlier wait lie before the recording, and no earlier entry into i is recorded. -/
def historyCfg : Cfg :=
  { yStart := cm (-1325), dist := profSlow 20, speed := speedSlow 20, display := fun _ => steady .left }
def history_boundaryTrace : Trace := traceOf historyCfg

/-- `branch_1` (violated): As in permit, but the motorcycle turns right (opposite the left arrow; drv.motion.right_turn_through_region at the exit) while a dev.regulatory_sign with code no_right_turn governs c. -/
def branch1Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with turn := -1, sign := some (turnSign .noRightTurn [11]) }
def branch_1Trace : Trace := traceOf branch1Cfg

/-- `branch_2` (violated): As in permit, but a pedestrian occupies the crosswalk recorded as marking the entrance of the opposite carrier; the moving motorcycle's closest approach to it lies within the horizon at a centre distance below the clearance. -/
def branch2Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := pedStanding }
def branch_2Trace : Trace := traceOf branch2Cfg

/-- `branch_3` (compliant): As in permit, but a car crossing i eastbound is already past the
    motorcycle's line at its entry and moving away: no closest approach ahead below the clearance,
    no contact. -/
def branch3Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := carAhead }

/-- `branch_4` (violated): The head shows circular_red with green_arrow(right); the motorcycle waits
    two cycles, turns left (opposite the arrow) while a no_left_turn sign governs i. -/
def branch4Cfg : Cfg :=
  { permitCfg with display := dispCycles .right, turn := 1, sign := some (turnSign .noLeftTurn [10]) }

/-- `branch_5` (violated): As in permit, but the head shows circular_green for part of the wait (the
    signal changed for the waiting motorcycle); red with the arrow again at the entry. -/
def branch5Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with display := dispGreenInWait }

/-- `branch_6` (compliant): No stop line; a crosswalk recorded as marking c; the motorcycle halts
    1.25 m short of it, waits two cycles and proceeds straight. -/
def branch6Cfg : Cfg :=
  { permitCfg with yStart := cm (-2125), n := 110, structs := [interS, laneC, laneOpp, cwNorth, cwSouth] }

/-- `branch_7` (compliant): No stop line or crosswalk marks c (the crosswalk present marks the
    opposite lane); the motorcycle halts 1.25 m short of i, waits two cycles and proceeds. -/
def branch7Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with yStart := cm (-1725), structs := noMarkStructs }

/-- `branch_8` (violated): No mark of c; the motorcycle rides into i without halting. -/
def branch8Cfg : Cfg := { runCfg with structs := noMarkStructs }

/-- `occasion_s1` (violated): The head displays circular_red with green_arrow(left) at the motorcycle's entry into i, made without any halt; it changes to circular_green while the motorcycle is in i; it exits straight ahead. -/
def occS1Cfg : Cfg := { runCfg with display := fun k => if k < 40 then steady .left else [.circularGreen] }
def occasion_s1Trace : Trace := traceOf occS1Cfg

/-- `occasion_s1_outside` (not_applicable): The head displays red with the green arrow while the motorcycle approaches, and circular_green from before its entry into i; it proceeds straight without halting. -/
def occS1OutCfg : Cfg := { runCfg with display := fun k => if k < 20 then steady .left else [.circularGreen] }
def occasion_s1_outsideTrace : Trace := traceOf occS1OutCfg

/-- `occasion_s3` (violated): At its entry the motorcycle's footprint overlaps c (governed by the red-with-arrow head) and i; afterwards only i; it did not halt and exits straight. -/
def occasion_s3Trace : Trace := traceOf runCfg

/-- `occasion_s3_outside` (not_applicable): The motorcycle occupied c while c's head showed red with the green arrow, then moved into an adjacent approach lane c2 whose governing head displays circular_green, and entered i from c2 only, exiting straight. -/
def occS3OutCfg : Cfg :=
  { runCfg with xShiftY := some (m (-20)), withHead2 := true, structs := baseStructs ++ [laneC2] }
def occasion_s3_outsideTrace : Trace := traceOf occS3OutCfg

/-- `occasion_s8` (violated): As in permit, but for part of the passage a pedestrian occupies a crosswalk of i on a converging course; the moving motorcycle's closest approach to it lies within the horizon below the clearance while the pedestrian is in the crosswalk. -/
def occS8Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := pedCrossing }
def occasion_s8Trace : Trace := traceOf occS8Cfg

/-- `occasion_s8_outside` (compliant): As in permit, but a pedestrian occupied a crosswalk of i only before the motorcycle's entry and has left it before the entry; no other road user is present during the passage. -/
def occS8OutCfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := pedLeaving }
def occasion_s8_outsideTrace : Trace := traceOf occS8OutCfg

/-- `occasion_s9` (violated): As in permit, but for part of the passage another car occupies i on a converging course; the moving motorcycle's closest approach to it lies within the horizon below the clearance. -/
def occS9Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := carConflict }
def occasion_s9Trace : Trace := traceOf occS9Cfg

/-- `occasion_s9_outside` (compliant): As in permit, but another car occupied i only before the motorcycle's entry and left it before the entry. -/
def occS9OutCfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := carGone }
def occasion_s9_outsideTrace : Trace := traceOf occS9OutCfg

def witness (name : String) (c : Cfg) (expected : Verdict)
    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "") : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "NRS_484B_307_9b"
    trace := traceOf c
    reading := {}          -- ignored by the gate: the run's reading is substituted
    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("subject", 1)]
    expected := expected
    window := windowOf c
    boundary := boundary }

def scenarios : List Scenario :=
  [ witness "forbid" forbidCfg .violated
  , witness "permit" permitCfg .compliant
  , witness "idle" idleCfg .notApplicable
  , witness "blind" forbidCfg (.unknown []) ["dev.traffic_signal"]
  , witness "history_boundary" historyCfg (.unknown []) (boundary := "the motorcycle's approach to the stop line on c and any run at rest there before the recording began")
  , witness "branch_1" branch1Cfg .violated
  , witness "branch_2" branch2Cfg .violated
  , witness "branch_3" branch3Cfg .compliant
  , witness "branch_4" branch4Cfg .violated
  , witness "branch_5" branch5Cfg .violated
  , witness "branch_6" branch6Cfg .compliant
  , witness "branch_7" branch7Cfg .compliant
  , witness "branch_8" branch8Cfg .violated
  , witness "occasion_s1" occS1Cfg .violated
  , witness "occasion_s1_outside" occS1OutCfg .notApplicable
  , witness "occasion_s3" runCfg .violated
  , witness "occasion_s3_outside" occS3OutCfg .notApplicable
  , witness "occasion_s8" occS8Cfg .violated
  , witness "occasion_s8_outside" occS8OutCfg .compliant
  , witness "occasion_s9" occS9Cfg .violated
  , witness "occasion_s9_outside" occS9OutCfg .compliant ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_307_9b
