/-- A quantity. -/
  inductive Term
    | lit (q : Q) (unit : PUnit')                            -- written through a Units constructor
    | param (name : ParamName)                               -- a reading parameter
    | measure (atom : String) (args : List Arg)              -- a measured atom (Option Q or Option Nat)
    | quantity (concept : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Q-valued derived concept
    | distanceWhile (subject : String) (φ : Formula)         -- path length over which φ has held continuously
    | sinceRise (φ : Formula)                                -- time elapsed since φ last became true
    /-- The signed heading change (degrees, left positive) of `subject`, integrated from its yaw
        rate, since ψ last became true: from the latest observation at which ψ rose definitely (false
        at the observation before, true there), counted from zero at that observation. ψ turning false
        does not end it, nor does a stop; only the next definite rise of ψ starts it again. Unknown
        where no such rise is observed with ψ known at every observation since (an onset before the
        recording, or one an unknown value of ψ could hide), where an interval between consecutive
        observations from the one before the rise onwards is longer than `maxStep`, or where a yaw
        rate since the rise is missing. `maxStep` is a literal or a reading parameter, a time,
        strictly positive: the sampling standard of the integration, not a window and not a bound on
        how far back the onset may lie. -/
    | headingSince (subject : String) (maxStep : Term) (ψ : Formula)   -- the heading change of subject since ψ last became true
    | aggregate (op : AggOp) (var : String) (φ : Formula) (t : Term)   -- op of t over the road users var of the scene satisfying φ
    | add (a b : Term)
    | sub (a b : Term)
    | mul (a b : Term)
    /-- `a / b`, unknown wherever `b` is zero. Its divisor reads no measured atom: a measurement can
        be zero (a straight way's curvature, a halted road user's speed), so a bound on a ratio is
        written as a bound on a product (a ratio below a bound is the dividend below the bound
        times the divisor). -/
    | div (a b : Term)
    | neg (a : Term)
    | abs (a : Term)
    | cond (φ : Formula) (a b : Term)                        -- a where φ holds, b where it does not
  /-- A three-valued statement about the trace at an instant. -/
  inductive Formula
    | tt
    | ff
    | atom (name : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Boolean atom; params for tolerances
    | cmp (lhs : Term) (op : CmpOp) (rhs : Term)
    | asm (id : AsmId)
    | intent (id : IntId) (who target : Arg)                 -- the declaration current here: road user `who` intends `id` at region `target`
    | same (a b : Arg)                                        -- the two variables denote the same entity
    | not (φ : Formula)
    | and (φ ψ : Formula)
    | or (φ ψ : Formula)
    | implies (φ ψ : Formula)
    | always (φ : Formula)                                    -- from now to the end of the trace
    | eventually (φ : Formula)                                -- φ here or at some later observation, to the end of the trace
    | until (φ ψ : Formula)                                   -- strong until, future
    | since (φ ψ : Formula)                                   -- past mirror of until
    | holdsFor (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ : Formula)   -- φ at every observation in the window behind
    | within (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ : Formula)     -- φ at some observation in the window ahead
    | untilWithin (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ ψ : Formula)   -- ψ at some observation in the window ahead, φ at every one before it
    | atLast (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (ψ φ : Formula)   -- φ at the last observation in the window behind at which ψ held
    | count (edge : Formula) (sinceφ : Formula) (op : CmpOp) (n : Nat)   -- rising edges of `edge` since `sinceφ` became true (start of its latest run)
    | rises (φ : Formula)                                     -- φ here and not at the previous observation
    | definedWhen (pre φ : Formula)                           -- φ where `pre` holds; unknown (undefined) where it does not
    | derived (concept : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Boolean derived concept
    | rule (id : String) (map : List (String × String))       -- another rule complied with (not engaged counts as complied)
    | ruleApplies (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) -- another rule engaged (its binders' classes and applicability hold)
    | existsUser (var : String) (φ : Formula)                 -- some road user present in the scene
    | forallUser (var : String) (φ : Formula)
    | existsRegion (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
    | forallRegion (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
    | existsDevice (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
    | forallDevice (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
end

/-- The atom a window over a measure reads: the clock, or the subject's path length. -/
def measureAtom : Measure → String
  | .time => "kin_time"
  | .path => "kin_path_length"

/-- The kind atom a quantifier with a literal kind reads (`existsRegion (.lit "lane")` reads
    `st_lane`); a variable kind is a concept's literal formal, read once the instance fills it. -/
def kindAtom (prefix_ : String) : Arg → List String
  | .lit k => [prefix_ ++ k]

-- The atom names a formula reads (for the gate, the manifest and the export): every leaf, the
-- measure of every window, and the kind of every quantifier with a literal kind.
mutual

    | .measure a _ => [a]
    | .quantity c _ ps => c :: (ps.flatMap termAtoms)
    | .distanceWhile _ φ => measureAtom .path :: atoms φ
    | .sinceRise φ => measureAtom .time :: atoms φ

    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => atoms φ ++ termAtoms t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termAtoms a ++ termAtoms b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termAtoms a
    | .cond φ a b => atoms φ ++ termAtoms a ++ termAtoms b
    | _ => []

    | .atom n _ ps => n :: ps.flatMap termAtoms
    | .cmp l _ r => termAtoms l ++ termAtoms r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => atoms φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
    | .holdsFor m d _ φ | .within m d _ φ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms φ
    | .untilWithin m d _ φ ψ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
    | .atLast m d _ ψ φ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms ψ ++ atoms φ
    | .count e s _ _ => atoms e ++ atoms s
    | .derived c _ ps => c :: ps.flatMap termAtoms
    | .existsRegion k _ φ | .forallRegion k _ φ => kindAtom "st_" k ++ atoms φ
    | .existsDevice k _ φ | .forallDevice k _ φ => kindAtom "dev_" k ++ atoms φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => atoms φ
    | _ => []
end

mutual

316	/-- The formula with its `k`-th leaf (traversal order) replaced by `r`, and the number of leaves
317	    in the formula. A subformula whose leaves all precede or follow the `k`-th is returned as it is. -/
318	partial def replaceLeafAux (k : Nat) (r : Formula) : Formula → Formula × Nat
319	  | φ@(.atom ..) | φ@(.cmp ..) | φ@(.asm _) | φ@(.intent ..) | φ@(.derived ..) | φ@(.rule ..) | φ@(.ruleApplies ..) =>
320	    (if k = 0 then r else φ, 1)
321	  | .not φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.not φ', n)
322	  | .always φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.always φ', n)
323	  | .eventually φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.eventually φ', n)
324	  | .and φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.and φ' ψ', n)
325	  | .or φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.or φ' ψ', n)
326	  | .implies φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.implies φ' ψ', n)
327	  | .until φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.until φ' ψ', n)
328	  | .since φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.since φ' ψ', n)
329	  | .holdsFor m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.holdsFor m d s φ', n)
330	  | .within m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.within m d s φ', n)
331	  | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.untilWithin m d s φ' ψ', n)
332	  | .atLast m d s ψ φ => let (ψ', φ', n) := two k r ψ φ; (.atLast m d s ψ' φ', n)
333	  | .count e s op c => let (e', s', n) := two k r e s; (.count e' s' op c, n)
334	  | .rises φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.rises φ', n)
335	  | .definedWhen p φ => let (p', φ', n) := two k r p φ; (.definedWhen p' φ', n)
336	  | .existsRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsRegion kd v φ', n)
337	  | .forallRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallRegion kd v φ', n)
338	  | .existsDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsDevice kd v φ', n)
339	  | .forallDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallDevice kd v φ', n)
340	  | .existsUser v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsUser v φ', n)

344	  /-- Two subformulas in sequence: the right one is touched only when the target leaf lies in it. -/
345	  two (k : Nat) (r : Formula) (φ ψ : Formula) : Formula × Formula × Nat :=

347	    if k < n then (φ', ψ, n + leafCount ψ)
348	    else let (ψ', m) := replaceLeafAux (k - n) r ψ; (φ', ψ', n + m)

  | .ruleApplies id _ => [s!"ruleApplies {id}"]
  | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => leaves φ
  | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
  | .holdsFor _ _ _ φ | .within _ _ _ φ => leaves φ
  | .untilWithin _ _ _ φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
  | .atLast _ _ _ ψ φ => leaves ψ ++ leaves φ
  | .count e s _ _ => leaves e ++ leaves s
  | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
  | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => leaves φ
  | _ => []

def leafCount (φ : Formula) : Nat := (leaves φ).length

/-- The formula with its `k`-th leaf (traversal order) replaced by `r`, and the number of leaves
    in the formula. A subformula whose leaves all precede or follow the `k`-th is returned as it is. -/
partial def replaceLeafAux (k : Nat) (r : Formula) : Formula → Formula × Nat
  | φ@(.atom ..) | φ@(.cmp ..) | φ@(.asm _) | φ@(.intent ..) | φ@(.derived ..) | φ@(.rule ..) | φ@(.ruleApplies ..) =>
    (if k = 0 then r else φ, 1)
  | .not φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.not φ', n)
  | .always φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.always φ', n)
  | .eventually φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.eventually φ', n)
  | .and φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.and φ' ψ', n)
  | .or φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.or φ' ψ', n)
  | .implies φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.implies φ' ψ', n)
  | .until φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.until φ' ψ', n)
  | .since φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.since φ' ψ', n)
  | .holdsFor m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.holdsFor m d s φ', n)
  | .within m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.within m d s φ', n)
  | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.untilWithin m d s φ' ψ', n)
  | .atLast m d s ψ φ => let (ψ', φ', n) := two k r ψ φ; (.atLast m d s ψ' φ', n)
  | .count e s op c => let (e', s', n) := two k r e s; (.count e' s' op c, n)
  | .rises φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.rises φ', n)
  | .definedWhen p φ => let (p', φ', n) := two k r p φ; (.definedWhen p' φ', n)
  | .existsRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsRegion kd v φ', n)
  | .forallRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallRegion kd v φ', n)
  | .existsDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsDevice kd v φ', n)
  | .forallDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallDevice kd v φ', n)
  | .existsUser v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsUser v φ', n)
  | .forallUser v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallUser v φ', n)
  | φ => (φ, 0)
where
  /-- Two subformulas in sequence: the right one is touched only when the target leaf lies in it. -/
  two (k : Nat) (r : Formula) (φ ψ : Formula) : Formula × Formula × Nat :=
    let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ
    if k < n then (φ', ψ, n + leafCount ψ)
    else let (ψ', m) := replaceLeafAux (k - n) r ψ; (φ', ψ', n + m)

/-- The formula with its `k`-th leaf replaced by `r`. -/
def replaceLeaf (k : Nat) (r : Formula) (φ : Formula) : Formula := (replaceLeafAux k r φ).1

-- The assumptions and the declared intentions a formula reads, at any depth of formulas and terms.
mutual
  partial def termDeclared : Term → List (Sum AsmId IntId)
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termDeclared
    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => declared φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termDeclared g ++ declared ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => declared φ ++ termDeclared t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termDeclared a ++ termDeclared b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termDeclared a
    | .cond φ a b => declared φ ++ termDeclared a ++ termDeclared b
    | _ => []
  partial def declared : Formula → List (Sum AsmId IntId)
    | .asm id => [.inl id]
    | .intent id _ _ => [.inr id]
    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termDeclared

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula
  The specification language, as data.

  A rule is an AST, not a Lean proposition, for three downstream reasons: the gate inspects it
  (which atoms, which operators, which parameters, any bare literal), the export serializes it for
  the tooling outside Lean, and the evaluator computes a three-valued verdict from it on a trace. Variables are strings bound by the grounding
  to tracks, and by the bounded quantifiers below to regions and devices of a kind.

  Atoms, primitives and concepts are referenced BY NAME (the Lean definition names of Atoms.lean
  and Primitives.lean, `family_name`; a concept's `drv_<family>_<name>`), with arguments that are variables, enumeration values spelled as in
  ATOMS.md, or naturals. Semantics.lean dispatches the names; the doctor checks every name resolves.

  A quantifier over road users ranges over every road user of the scene, the bound ones included;
  `same a b` is how a body excludes the subject from "another road user".

  The bounded quantifiers take their kind as an `Arg`: a rule spells it (`.lit "intersection"`),
  a concept fills it from a literal formal on expansion. `rises` is an edge against the previous
  observation, not a frame: it says nothing about what happened between two observations.

  `cond φ a b` selects between two quantities. A comparison over it is decided wherever both
  selections decide it alike, so an unobserved φ leaves a verdict open only where the choice
  matters (`elimCond`, applied before evaluation).

  Deliberately absent: `next` (frame-relative and meaningless under irregular sampling), any
  numeric literal without a unit, any way to call an arbitrary Lean function.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Params
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World

namespace TrafficSpec

/-- A value a formula variable can denote. -/
inductive Val
  | track (t : TrackId)
  | region (r : RegionId)
  | device (d : DeviceId)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def Val.kind : Val → EntityKind
  | .track _ => .track
  | .region _ => .region
  | .device _ => .device

/-- Variable bindings (the grounding's output; `Env` is the world's environment record). -/
structure Binding where
  binds : List (String × Val) := []
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace Binding
def lookup (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option Val := (e.binds.find? (·.1 == n)).map (·.2)
def bind (e : Binding) (n : String) (v : Val) : Binding := ⟨(n, v) :: e.binds.filter (·.1 != n)⟩
def track (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option TrackId :=
  match e.lookup n with | some (.track t) => some t | _ => none
def region (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option RegionId :=
  match e.lookup n with | some (.region r) => some r | _ => none
def device (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option DeviceId :=
  match e.lookup n with | some (.device d) => some d | _ => none
end Binding

/-- An argument to an atom or a derived concept. -/
inductive Arg
  | var (name : String)      -- a bound variable
  | lit (value : String)     -- an enumeration value, spelled as in the ontology
  | nat (n : Nat)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

inductive CmpOp
  | lt | le | eq | ge | gt
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

/-- What an aggregate over road users computes. -/
inductive AggOp
  | min | max | median | count
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def AggOp.toString : AggOp → String
  | .min => "min" | .max => "max" | .median => "median" | .count => "count"
instance : ToString AggOp := ⟨AggOp.toString⟩

def CmpOp.apply : CmpOp → Q → Q → Bool
  | .lt, a, b => Q.lt a b
  | .le, a, b => Q.le a b
  | .eq, a, b => Q.eq a b
  | .ge, a, b => Q.ge a b
  | .gt, a, b => Q.gt a b

mutual

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mm (n : Int) : Q := Units.millimetres n
def qk (k : Nat) : Q := Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy from body rectangles
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Box where
  x0 : Q
  y0 : Q
  x1 : Q
  y1 : Q

def overlaps (a b : Box) : Bool :=
  Q.lt a.x0 b.x1 && Q.lt b.x0 a.x1 && Q.lt a.y0 b.y1 && Q.lt b.y0 a.y1

def bbox (poly : List Vec) : Box :=
  match poly with
  | [] => ⟨Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero⟩
  | p :: ps => ps.foldl (fun b q => ⟨Q.min b.x0 q.1, Q.min b.y0 q.2, Q.max b.x1 q.1, Q.max b.y1 q.2⟩)
      ⟨p.1, p.2, p.1, p.2⟩

/-- The body rectangle of a user heading along an axis. -/
def userBox (u : RoadUser) : Option Box := do
  let p ← u.kin.position
  let h ← u.kin.heading
  let (hl, hw, _) ← u.kin.extent
  let ax := if Q.isZero h.1 then hw else hl
  let ay := if Q.isZero h.1 then hl else hw
  pure ⟨Q.sub p.1 ax, Q.sub p.2 ay, Q.add p.1 ax, Q.add p.2 ay⟩

def occupancy (users : List RoadUser) (structs : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match userBox u with
    | none => []
    | some b => structs.filterMap fun st =>

        | some poly => if overlaps b (bbox poly) then some (u.track, st.id) else none
        | none => none

  Branch scenes add a south crosswalk (16, y −14…−11, marking c) or remove the marks, or add a
  second northbound approach lane c2 (15, x 4…8) governed by its own head (31, circular_green).
  The head (30) governs c and shows the display of each scene; a regulatory sign (32) governs c or i.

  The motorcycle (track 1; half-extents 1 × 0.4 m) rides at x = 2 heading north. Every scene is
  sampled at 50 ms (the step bound of the turn concepts), so the integration of the yaw rate
  (observed, zero when straight) is defined across the passage. Occupancy is stated from the body
  rectangle (a body across c and i at its entry overlaps both).
  Halting scenes: approach at 4 m/s from 5 m behind the halt point (the first frames are the
  approach start: the body is more than 2 m short of the mark), at rest from frame 25 to 45 with
  its front 1.25 m short of the mark, then 10 m/s: entry at frame 50, straight exit at frame 94.
  Non-halting scenes: 10 m/s from y = −25. Display cycles: red alone, then red with the arrow from
  frame 30, red alone from 35, red with the arrow from 40 (two rises during the wait); the forbid
  display rises once (frame 30).

import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_307_9b
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_307_9b

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mm (n : Int) : Q := Units.millimetres n
def qk (k : Nat) : Q := Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy from body rectangles
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Box where
  x0 : Q
  y0 : Q
  x1 : Q
  y1 : Q

def overlaps (a b : Box) : Bool :=
  Q.lt a.x0 b.x1 && Q.lt b.x0 a.x1 && Q.lt a.y0 b.y1 && Q.lt b.y0 a.y1

def bbox (poly : List Vec) : Box :=
  match poly with
  | [] => ⟨Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero⟩
  | p :: ps => ps.foldl (fun b q => ⟨Q.min b.x0 q.1, Q.min b.y0 q.2, Q.max b.x1 q.1, Q.max b.y1 q.2⟩)
      ⟨p.1, p.2, p.1, p.2⟩

/-- The body rectangle of a user heading along an axis. -/
def userBox (u : RoadUser) : Option Box := do
  let p ← u.kin.position
  let h ← u.kin.heading
  let (hl, hw, _) ← u.kin.extent
  let ax := if Q.isZero h.1 then hw else hl
  let ay := if Q.isZero h.1 then hl else hw
  pure ⟨Q.sub p.1 ax, Q.sub p.2 ay, Q.add p.1 ax, Q.add p.2 ay⟩

def occupancy (users : List RoadUser) (structs : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match userBox u with
    | none => []
    | some b => structs.filterMap fun st =>
        match st.boundary with
        | some poly => if overlaps b (bbox poly) then some (u.track, st.id) else none
        | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Structures and devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rectPts (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : List Vec := [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

def interS : Structure := Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 10)
def laneC : Structure := Build.lane 11 (rectPts (m 0) (m (-60)) (m 4) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def stopLineS : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 12 .stopLine (m 0) (m (-11)) (m 4) (cm (-1050)) with entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true }
def laneOpp : Structure := Build.lane 13 (rectPts (m (-4)) (m 10) (m 0) (m 60)) Build.south (enters := some 10)
def cwNorth : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 14 .crosswalk (m (-10)) (m 11) (m 10) (m 14) with
    entranceOf := [13], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }
def laneC2 : Structure := Build.lane 15 (rectPts (m 4) (m (-60)) (m 8) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def cwSouth : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 16 .crosswalk (m (-10)) (m (-14)) (m 10) (m (-11)) with
    entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }

/-- A stop line on the opposite lane, marking that lane only. -/
def stopLineOpp : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 17 .stopLine (m (-4)) (cm 1450) (m 0) (m 15) with entranceOf := [13], entranceObserved := true }

def baseStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, stopLineS, laneOpp, cwNorth]
def cwStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, laneOpp, cwNorth, cwSouth]
def noMarkStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, laneOpp, cwNorth, stopLineOpp]

def head2 : Device := Build.signal 31 [15] [.circularGreen]
def turnSign (code : SignCode) (gov : List RegionId) : Device :=
  { Build.sign 32 .regulatorySign gov with code := some code, conditions := some {} }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Displays
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def steady (dir : ArrowDir) : List SignalIndication := [.circularRed, .greenArrow dir]
/-- Two rises of red-with-arrow during the wait (frames 30 and 40). -/
def dispCycles (dir : ArrowDir) (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady dir
  else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady dir
/-- One rise only (frame 30). -/
def dispOnce (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else steady .left
/-- Two rises, but circular_green for frames 35–37 of the wait. -/
def dispGreenInWait (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady .left
  else if k < 38 then [.circularGreen] else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady .left

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Motion profiles: distance travelled and speed by frame
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def profHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ kh then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk k)
  else if k ≤ kg then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)
  else Q.add (Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - kg)))
def speedHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < kh then Units.metresPerSecond 4 else if k ≤ kg then Q.zero else Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profConst (k : Nat) : Q := Q.mul (cm 50) (qk k)
def speedConst (_k : Nat) : Q := Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ ks then Q.mul (mm 25) (qk k) else Q.add (Q.mul (mm 25) (qk ks)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - ks)))
def speedSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < ks then cm 50 else Units.metresPerSecond 10

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A scene configuration
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Cfg where
  n : Nat := 100
  yStart : Q
  dist : Nat → Q
  speed : Nat → Q
  /-- 0 straight, 1 left, −1 right; the turn is made at `yTurn`, the yaw rate set over frames
      `yawFrom`…`yawTo` (±90 deg/s, 20 frames: ±90 degrees). -/
  turn : Int := 0
  yTurn : Q := cm (-575)
  yawFrom : Nat := 56
  yawTo : Nat := 75
  /-- Lane change to x = 6 (lane c2) once the reference point reaches this y. -/
  xShiftY : Option Q := none
  display : Nat → List SignalIndication
  headGov : List RegionId := [11]
  withHead2 : Bool := false
  sign : Option Device := none
  structs : List Structure := baseStructs
  others : Nat → List RoadUser := fun _ => []

def subjectAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let d := c.dist k
  let y := Q.add c.yStart d
  let dTurn := Q.sub c.yTurn c.yStart
  let x0 : Q := match c.xShiftY with
    | some ys => if Q.le ys y then m 6 else m 2
    | none => m 2
  let straight := c.turn == 0 || Q.le d dTurn
  let pos : Vec :=
    if straight then (x0, y)
    else if c.turn > 0 then (Q.sub x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
    else (Q.add x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
  let hd : Vec := if straight then Build.north else if c.turn > 0 then Build.west else Build.east
  let yaw : Q :=
    if c.turn != 0 && decide (c.yawFrom ≤ k) && decide (k ≤ c.yawTo) then
      (if c.turn > 0 then Units.degrees 90 else Units.degrees (-90))
    else Q.zero
  Build.withKin (Build.user 1 [.motorcycle] pos hd (c.speed k) (m 1, cm 40, cm 70))
    fun kin => { kin with yawRate := some yaw }

def sceneAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) (t : Timestamp) : Scene :=
  let users := subjectAt c k :: c.others k
  let devs := [Build.signal 30 c.headGov (c.display k)] ++ (if c.withHead2 then [head2] else []) ++ c.sign.toList
  Build.scene t (some 1) users c.structs devs (occupies := some (occupancy users c.structs))

def traceOf (c : Cfg) : Trace := Build.trace c.n 0 (Units.milliseconds 50) (sceneAt c)
def windowOf (c : Cfg) : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := some (50, Int.ofNat ((c.n - 1) * 50))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Other road users
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def ped (pos : Vec) (hd : Vec) (v : Q) : RoadUser := Build.user 2 [.pedestrian] pos hd v (cm 30, cm 30, cm 90)
def car (x : Q) : RoadUser := Build.user 3 [.motorVehicle] (x, m 3) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 8) (cm 225, m 1, cm 75)

/-- Standing in the north crosswalk (marking the opposite lane), 2 m left of the motorcycle's line. -/
def pedStanding (_k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [ped (m 0, cm 1250) Build.west Q.zero]
/-- North of the crosswalk until frame 50, then walking south at 1.5 m/s into it (from frame 67),
    1.5 m right of the motorcycle's line. -/
def pedCrossing (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  if k ≤ 50 then [ped (cm 350, cm 1550) Build.south Q.zero]
  else [ped (cm 350, Q.sub (cm 1550) (Q.mul (mm 75) (qk (k - 50)))) Build.south (cm 150)]
/-- In the north crosswalk at the start, walking west at 1.5 m/s; off it from frame 35. -/
def pedLeaving (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  [ped (Q.sub (m (-8)) (Q.mul (mm 75) (qk k)), cm 1250) Build.west (cm 150)]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, 8 m/s, entering i at frame 51 on a course whose centre miss distance with
    the motorcycle is 2.7 m. -/
def carConflict (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (cm (-1250)) (Q.mul (cm 40) (Q.sub (qk k) (qk 50))))]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, out of i from frame 44. -/
def carGone (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (m (-5)) (Q.mul (cm 40) (qk k)))]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, already past the motorcycle's line at its entry and moving away; in i until frame 70. -/
def carAhead (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (m 4) (Q.mul (cm 40) (Q.sub (qk k) (qk 50))))]

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Configurations
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def permitCfg : Cfg :=
  { yStart := cm (-1825), dist := profHalt 25 45, speed := speedHalt 25 45, display := dispCycles .left }
def forbidCfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with display := dispOnce }
def runCfg : Cfg :=
  { yStart := m (-25), dist := profConst, speed := speedConst, display := fun _ => steady .left }

/-- `forbid` (violated): A motorcycle (ru.aggregate motorcycle) occupies approach lane c entering i, with a stop line recorded as marking c; the head governing c displays circular_red with green_arrow(left). The motorcycle halts at the stop line, waits while the red-with-arrow display comes on again once only, then enters i and exits straight ahead (no turn concept holds). No pedestrian or other road user is present. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace := traceOf forbidCfg

/-- `permit` (compliant): As in forbid, but the motorcycle remains at rest at the stop line while the red-with-arrow display rises twice, the head never displays circular_green, and it then proceeds straight through i. No other road user is in the scene, so the yield is decided on the subject alone. -/
def permitTrace : Trace := traceOf permitCfg

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The head governing c displays circular_green at the motorcycle's entry; it proceeds straight through. -/
def idleCfg : Cfg := { runCfg with display := fun _ => [.circularGreen] }
def idleTrace : Trace := traceOf idleCfg

/-- `blind` (unknown): As in forbid, but the state of the head governing c is never observed (dev.traffic_signal absent). -/
def blindTrace : Trace := traceOf forbidCfg

/-- `history_boundary` (unknown): The recording begins with the motorcycle already within the stop line's stopping zone on c, moving slowly, under red with green_arrow(left); it enters i and exits straight. No halt is recorded, the approach start and any earlier wait lie before the recording, and no earlier entry into i is recorded. -/
def historyCfg : Cfg :=
  { yStart := cm (-1325), dist := profSlow 20, speed := speedSlow 20, display := fun _ => steady .left }
def history_boundaryTrace : Trace := traceOf historyCfg

/-- `branch_1` (violated): As in permit, but the motorcycle turns right (opposite the left arrow; drv.motion.right_turn_through_region at the exit) while a dev.regulatory_sign with code no_right_turn governs c. -/
def branch1Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with turn := -1, sign := some (turnSign .noRightTurn [11]) }
def branch_1Trace : Trace := traceOf branch1Cfg

/-- `branch_2` (violated): As in permit, but a pedestrian occupies the crosswalk recorded as marking the entrance of the opposite carrier; the moving motorcycle's closest approach to it lies within the horizon at a centre distance below the clearance. -/
def branch2Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := pedStanding }
def branch_2Trace : Trace := traceOf branch2Cfg

/-- `branch_3` (compliant): As in permit, but a car crossing i eastbound is already past the
    motorcycle's line at its entry and moving away: no closest approach ahead below the clearance,
    no contact. -/
def branch3Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := carAhead }

/-- `branch_4` (violated): The head shows circular_red with green_arrow(right); the motorcycle waits
    two cycles, turns left (opposite the arrow) while a no_left_turn sign governs i. -/
def branch4Cfg : Cfg :=
  { permitCfg with display := dispCycles .right, turn := 1, sign := some (turnSign .noLeftTurn [10]) }

/-- `branch_5` (violated): As in permit, but the head shows circular_green for part of the wait (the
    signal changed for the waiting motorcycle); red with the arrow again at the entry. -/
def branch5Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with display := dispGreenInWait }

/-- `branch_6` (compliant): No stop line; a crosswalk recorded as marking c; the motorcycle halts
    1.25 m short of it, waits two cycles and proceeds straight. -/
def branch6Cfg : Cfg :=
  { permitCfg with yStart := cm (-2125), n := 110, structs := [interS, laneC, laneOpp, cwNorth, cwSouth] }

/-- `branch_7` (compliant): No stop line or crosswalk marks c (the crosswalk present marks the
    opposite lane); the motorcycle halts 1.25 m short of i, waits two cycles and proceeds. -/
def branch7Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with yStart := cm (-1725), structs := noMarkStructs }

/-- `branch_8` (violated): No mark of c; the motorcycle rides into i without halting. -/
def branch8Cfg : Cfg := { runCfg with structs := noMarkStructs }

/-- `occasion_s1` (violated): The head displays circular_red with green_arrow(left) at the motorcycle's entry into i, made without any halt; it changes to circular_green while the motorcycle is in i; it exits straight ahead. -/
def occS1Cfg : Cfg := { runCfg with display := fun k => if k < 40 then steady .left else [.circularGreen] }
def occasion_s1Trace : Trace := traceOf occS1Cfg

/-- `occasion_s1_outside` (not_applicable): The head displays red with the green arrow while the motorcycle approaches, and circular_green from before its entry into i; it proceeds straight without halting. -/
def occS1OutCfg : Cfg := { runCfg with display := fun k => if k < 20 then steady .left else [.circularGreen] }
def occasion_s1_outsideTrace : Trace := traceOf occS1OutCfg

/-- `occasion_s3` (violated): At its entry the motorcycle's footprint overlaps c (governed by the red-with-arrow head) and i; afterwards only i; it did not halt and exits straight. -/
def occasion_s3Trace : Trace := traceOf runCfg

/-- `occasion_s3_outside` (not_applicable): The motorcycle occupied c while c's head showed red with the green arrow, then moved into an adjacent approach lane c2 whose governing head displays circular_green, and entered i from c2 only, exiting straight. -/
def occS3OutCfg : Cfg :=
  { runCfg with xShiftY := some (m (-20)), withHead2 := true, structs := baseStructs ++ [laneC2] }
def occasion_s3_outsideTrace : Trace := traceOf occS3OutCfg

def occS8Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := pedCrossing }
def occasion_s8Trace : Trace := traceOf occS8Cfg

/-- `occasion_s8_outside` (compliant): As in permit, but a pedestrian occupied a crosswalk of i only before the motorcycle's entry and has left it before the entry; no other road user is present during the passage. -/
def occS8OutCfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := pedLeaving }
def occasion_s8_outsideTrace : Trace := traceOf occS8OutCfg

/-- `occasion_s9` (violated): As in permit, but for part of the passage another car occupies i on a converging course; the moving motorcycle's closest approach to it lies within the horizon below the clearance. -/
def occS9Cfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := carConflict }
def occasion_s9Trace : Trace := traceOf occS9Cfg

/-- `occasion_s9_outside` (compliant): As in permit, but another car occupied i only before the motorcycle's entry and left it before the entry. -/
def occS9OutCfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with others := carGone }
def occasion_s9_outsideTrace : Trace := traceOf occS9OutCfg

    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "") : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "NRS_484B_307_9b"
    trace := traceOf c

    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("subject", 1)]

  , witness "permit" permitCfg .compliant

  , witness "history_boundary" historyCfg (.unknown []) (boundary := "the motorcycle's approach to the stop line on c and any run at rest there before the recording began")

  , witness "branch_4" branch4Cfg .violated
  , witness "branch_5" branch5Cfg .violated
  , witness "branch_6" branch6Cfg .compliant
  , witness "branch_7" branch7Cfg .compliant
  , witness "branch_8" branch8Cfg .violated
  , witness "occasion_s1" occS1Cfg .violated
  , witness "occasion_s1_outside" occS1OutCfg .notApplicable
  , witness "occasion_s3" runCfg .violated
  , witness "occasion_s3_outside" occS3OutCfg .notApplicable
  , witness "occasion_s8" occS8Cfg .violated

  , witness "occasion_s9_outside" occS9OutCfg .compliant ]

import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_307_9b
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_307_9b

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mm (n : Int) : Q := Units.millimetres n
def qk (k : Nat) : Q := Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy from body rectangles
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Box where
  x0 : Q
  y0 : Q
  x1 : Q
  y1 : Q

def overlaps (a b : Box) : Bool :=
  Q.lt a.x0 b.x1 && Q.lt b.x0 a.x1 && Q.lt a.y0 b.y1 && Q.lt b.y0 a.y1

def bbox (poly : List Vec) : Box :=
  match poly with
  | [] => ⟨Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero⟩
  | p :: ps => ps.foldl (fun b q => ⟨Q.min b.x0 q.1, Q.min b.y0 q.2, Q.max b.x1 q.1, Q.max b.y1 q.2⟩)
      ⟨p.1, p.2, p.1, p.2⟩

/-- The body rectangle of a user heading along an axis. -/
def userBox (u : RoadUser) : Option Box := do
  let p ← u.kin.position
  let h ← u.kin.heading
  let (hl, hw, _) ← u.kin.extent
  let ax := if Q.isZero h.1 then hw else hl
  let ay := if Q.isZero h.1 then hl else hw
  pure ⟨Q.sub p.1 ax, Q.sub p.2 ay, Q.add p.1 ax, Q.add p.2 ay⟩

def occupancy (users : List RoadUser) (structs : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match userBox u with
    | none => []
    | some b => structs.filterMap fun st =>
        match st.boundary with
        | some poly => if overlaps b (bbox poly) then some (u.track, st.id) else none
        | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Structures and devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rectPts (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : List Vec := [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

def interS : Structure := Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 10)
def laneC : Structure := Build.lane 11 (rectPts (m 0) (m (-60)) (m 4) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def stopLineS : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 12 .stopLine (m 0) (m (-11)) (m 4) (cm (-1050)) with entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true }
def laneOpp : Structure := Build.lane 13 (rectPts (m (-4)) (m 10) (m 0) (m 60)) Build.south (enters := some 10)
def cwNorth : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 14 .crosswalk (m (-10)) (m 11) (m 10) (m 14) with
    entranceOf := [13], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }
def laneC2 : Structure := Build.lane 15 (rectPts (m 4) (m (-60)) (m 8) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def cwSouth : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 16 .crosswalk (m (-10)) (m (-14)) (m 10) (m (-11)) with
    entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }

/-- A stop line on the opposite lane, marking that lane only. -/
def stopLineOpp : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 17 .stopLine (m (-4)) (cm 1450) (m 0) (m 15) with entranceOf := [13], entranceObserved := true }

def baseStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, stopLineS, laneOpp, cwNorth]
def cwStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, laneOpp, cwNorth, cwSouth]
def noMarkStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, laneOpp, cwNorth, stopLineOpp]

def head2 : Device := Build.signal 31 [15] [.circularGreen]
def turnSign (code : SignCode) (gov : List RegionId) : Device :=
  { Build.sign 32 .regulatorySign gov with code := some code, conditions := some {} }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Displays
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def steady (dir : ArrowDir) : List SignalIndication := [.circularRed, .greenArrow dir]
/-- Two rises of red-with-arrow during the wait (frames 30 and 40). -/
def dispCycles (dir : ArrowDir) (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady dir
  else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady dir
/-- One rise only (frame 30). -/
def dispOnce (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else steady .left
/-- Two rises, but circular_green for frames 35–37 of the wait. -/
def dispGreenInWait (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady .left
  else if k < 38 then [.circularGreen] else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady .left

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Motion profiles: distance travelled and speed by frame
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def profHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ kh then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk k)
  else if k ≤ kg then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)
  else Q.add (Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - kg)))
def speedHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < kh then Units.metresPerSecond 4 else if k ≤ kg then Q.zero else Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profConst (k : Nat) : Q := Q.mul (cm 50) (qk k)
def speedConst (_k : Nat) : Q := Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ ks then Q.mul (mm 25) (qk k) else Q.add (Q.mul (mm 25) (qk ks)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - ks)))
def speedSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < ks then cm 50 else Units.metresPerSecond 10

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A scene configuration
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Cfg where
  n : Nat := 100
  yStart : Q
  dist : Nat → Q
  speed : Nat → Q
  /-- 0 straight, 1 left, −1 right; the turn is made at `yTurn`, the yaw rate set over frames
      `yawFrom`…`yawTo` (±90 deg/s, 20 frames: ±90 degrees). -/
  turn : Int := 0
  yTurn : Q := cm (-575)
  yawFrom : Nat := 56
  yawTo : Nat := 75
  /-- Lane change to x = 6 (lane c2) once the reference point reaches this y. -/
  xShiftY : Option Q := none
  display : Nat → List SignalIndication
  headGov : List RegionId := [11]
  withHead2 : Bool := false
  sign : Option Device := none
  extraDevs : List Device := []
  structs : List Structure := baseStructs
  others : Nat → List RoadUser := fun _ => []
  subjClasses : List RoadUserClass := [.motorcycle]

def subjectAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let d := c.dist k
  let y := Q.add c.yStart d
  let dTurn := Q.sub c.yTurn c.yStart
  let x0 : Q := match c.xShiftY with
    | some ys => if Q.le ys y then m 6 else m 2
    | none => m 2
  let straight := c.turn == 0 || Q.le d dTurn
  let pos : Vec :=
    if straight then (x0, y)
    else if c.turn > 0 then (Q.sub x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
    else (Q.add x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
  let hd : Vec := if straight then Build.north else if c.turn > 0 then Build.west else Build.east
  let yaw : Q :=
    if c.turn != 0 && decide (c.yawFrom ≤ k) && decide (k ≤ c.yawTo) then
      (if c.turn > 0 then Units.degrees 90 else Units.degrees (-90))
    else Q.zero
  Build.withKin (Build.user 1 [.motorcycle] pos hd (c.speed k) (m 1, cm 40, cm 70))
    fun kin => { kin with yawRate := some yaw }

def sceneAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) (t : Timestamp) : Scene :=
  let users := subjectAt c k :: c.others k
  let devs := [Build.signal 30 c.headGov (c.display k)] ++ (if c.withHead2 then [head2] else []) ++ c.sign.toList
  Build.scene t (some 1) users c.structs devs (occupies := some (occupancy users c.structs))

def traceOf (c : Cfg) : Trace := Build.trace c.n 0 (Units.milliseconds 50) (sceneAt c)
def windowOf (c : Cfg) : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := some (50, Int.ofNat ((c.n - 1) * 50))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Other road users
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def ped (pos : Vec) (hd : Vec) (v : Q) : RoadUser := Build.user 2 [.pedestrian] pos hd v (cm 30, cm 30, cm 90)
def car (x : Q) : RoadUser := Build.user 3 [.motorVehicle] (x, m 3) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 8) (cm 225, m 1, cm 75)

/-- Standing in the north crosswalk (marking the opposite lane), 2 m left of the motorcycle's line. -/
def pedStanding (_k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [ped (m 0, cm 1250) Build.west Q.zero]
/-- North of the crosswalk until frame 50, then walking south at 1.5 m/s into it (from frame 67),
    1.5 m right of the motorcycle's line. -/
def pedCrossing (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  if k ≤ 50 then [ped (cm 350, cm 1550) Build.south Q.zero]
  else [ped (cm 350, Q.sub (cm 1550) (Q.mul (mm 75) (qk (k - 50)))) Build.south (cm 150)]
/-- In the north crosswalk at the start, walking west at 1.5 m/s; off it from frame 35. -/
def pedLeaving (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  [ped (Q.sub (m (-8)) (Q.mul (mm 75) (qk k)), cm 1250) Build.west (cm 150)]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, 8 m/s, entering i at frame 51 on a course whose centre miss distance with
    the motorcycle is 2.7 m. -/
def carConflict (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (cm (-1250)) (Q.mul (cm 40) (Q.sub (qk k) (qk 50))))]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, out of i from frame 44. -/
def carGone (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (m (-5)) (Q.mul (cm 40) (qk k)))]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, already past the motorcycle's line at its entry and moving away; in i until frame 70. -/
def carAhead (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (m 4) (Q.mul (cm 40) (Q.sub (qk k) (qk 50))))]

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mm (n : Int) : Q := Units.millimetres n
def qk (k : Nat) : Q := Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy from body rectangles
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Box where
  x0 : Q
  y0 : Q
  x1 : Q
  y1 : Q

def overlaps (a b : Box) : Bool :=
  Q.lt a.x0 b.x1 && Q.lt b.x0 a.x1 && Q.lt a.y0 b.y1 && Q.lt b.y0 a.y1

def bbox (poly : List Vec) : Box :=
  match poly with
  | [] => ⟨Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero⟩
  | p :: ps => ps.foldl (fun b q => ⟨Q.min b.x0 q.1, Q.min b.y0 q.2, Q.max b.x1 q.1, Q.max b.y1 q.2⟩)
      ⟨p.1, p.2, p.1, p.2⟩

/-- The body rectangle of a user heading along an axis. -/
def userBox (u : RoadUser) : Option Box := do
  let p ← u.kin.position
  let h ← u.kin.heading
  let (hl, hw, _) ← u.kin.extent
  let ax := if Q.isZero h.1 then hw else hl
  let ay := if Q.isZero h.1 then hl else hw
  pure ⟨Q.sub p.1 ax, Q.sub p.2 ay, Q.add p.1 ax, Q.add p.2 ay⟩

def occupancy (users : List RoadUser) (structs : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=

    match userBox u with
    | none => []
    | some b => structs.filterMap fun st =>

        | none => none

  rectangle (a body across c and i at its entry overlaps both).
  Halting scenes: approach at 4 m/s from 5 m behind the halt point (the first frames are the
  approach start: the body is more than 2 m short of the mark), at rest from frame 25 to 45 with
  its front 1.25 m short of the mark, then 10 m/s: entry at frame 50, straight exit at frame 94.
  Non-halting scenes: 10 m/s from y = −25. Display cycles: red alone, then red with the arrow from
  frame 30, red alone from 35, red with the arrow from 40 (two rises during the wait); the forbid

import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_307_9b

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mm (n : Int) : Q := Units.millimetres n
def qk (k : Nat) : Q := Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy from body rectangles
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Box where
  x0 : Q
  y0 : Q
  x1 : Q
  y1 : Q

def overlaps (a b : Box) : Bool :=
  Q.lt a.x0 b.x1 && Q.lt b.x0 a.x1 && Q.lt a.y0 b.y1 && Q.lt b.y0 a.y1

def bbox (poly : List Vec) : Box :=
  match poly with
  | [] => ⟨Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero⟩
  | p :: ps => ps.foldl (fun b q => ⟨Q.min b.x0 q.1, Q.min b.y0 q.2, Q.max b.x1 q.1, Q.max b.y1 q.2⟩)
      ⟨p.1, p.2, p.1, p.2⟩

/-- The body rectangle of a user heading along an axis. -/
def userBox (u : RoadUser) : Option Box := do
  let p ← u.kin.position
  let h ← u.kin.heading
  let (hl, hw, _) ← u.kin.extent
  let ax := if Q.isZero h.1 then hw else hl
  let ay := if Q.isZero h.1 then hl else hw
  pure ⟨Q.sub p.1 ax, Q.sub p.2 ay, Q.add p.1 ax, Q.add p.2 ay⟩

def occupancy (users : List RoadUser) (structs : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match userBox u with
    | none => []
    | some b => structs.filterMap fun st =>
        match st.boundary with
        | some poly => if overlaps b (bbox poly) then some (u.track, st.id) else none
        | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Structures and devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rectPts (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : List Vec := [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

def interS : Structure := Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 10)
def laneC : Structure := Build.lane 11 (rectPts (m 0) (m (-60)) (m 4) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def stopLineS : Structure :=

def laneOpp : Structure := Build.lane 13 (rectPts (m (-4)) (m 10) (m 0) (m 60)) Build.south (enters := some 10)
def cwNorth : Structure :=

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def steady (dir : ArrowDir) : List SignalIndication := [.circularRed, .greenArrow dir]
/-- Two rises of red-with-arrow during the wait (frames 30 and 40). -/

  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady dir
  else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady dir
/-- One rise only (frame 30). -/

  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else steady .left
/-- Two rises, but circular_green for frames 35–37 of the wait. -/

  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady .left
  else if k < 38 then [.circularGreen] else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady .left

def profHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ kh then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk k)
  else if k ≤ kg then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)
  else Q.add (Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - kg)))
def speedHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < kh then Units.metresPerSecond 4 else if k ≤ kg then Q.zero else Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profConst (k : Nat) : Q := Q.mul (cm 50) (qk k)
def speedConst (_k : Nat) : Q := Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=

  yStart : Q

  structs : List Structure := baseStructs

  subjClasses : List RoadUserClass := [.motorcycle]

def subjectAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let d := c.dist k
  let y := Q.add c.yStart d
  let dTurn := Q.sub c.yTurn c.yStart

    | some ys => if Q.le ys y then m 6 else m 2
    | none => m 2

    else if c.turn > 0 then (Q.sub x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
    else (Q.add x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)

    else Q.zero

def sceneAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) (t : Timestamp) : Scene :=

/-

  Geometry (metres, +x east, +y north). Intersection i (10): the square x −10…10, y −10…10.
  Approach lane c (11): x 0…4, y −60…−10, direction north, entering i. Stop line (12): x 0…4,
  y −11…−10.5, recorded as marking c. Opposite approach lane (13): x −4…0, y 10…60, direction
  south, entering i; north crosswalk (14): x −10…10, y 11…14, recorded as marking lane 13.
  Branch scenes add a south crosswalk (16, y −14…−11, marking c) or remove the marks, or add a
  second northbound approach lane c2 (15, x 4…8) governed by its own head (31, circular_green).
  The head (30) governs c and shows the display of each scene; a regulatory sign (32) governs c or i.

  The motorcycle (track 1; half-extents 1 × 0.4 m) rides at x = 2 heading north. Every scene is
  sampled at 50 ms (the step bound of the turn concepts), so the integration of the yaw rate
  (observed, zero when straight) is defined across the passage. Occupancy is stated from the body
  rectangle (a body across c and i at its entry overlaps both).
  Halting scenes: approach at 4 m/s from 5 m behind the halt point (the first frames are the
  approach start: the body is more than 2 m short of the mark), at rest from frame 25 to 45 with
  its front 1.25 m short of the mark, then 10 m/s: entry at frame 50, straight exit at frame 94.
  Non-halting scenes: 10 m/s from y = −25. Display cycles: red alone, then red with the arrow from
  frame 30, red alone from 35, red with the arrow from 40 (two rises during the wait); the forbid
  display rises once (frame 30).

  so its entries and exits are not decided.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_307_9b
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_307_9b

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mm (n : Int) : Q := Units.millimetres n
def qk (k : Nat) : Q := Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy from body rectangles
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Box where
  x0 : Q
  y0 : Q
  x1 : Q
  y1 : Q

def overlaps (a b : Box) : Bool :=
  Q.lt a.x0 b.x1 && Q.lt b.x0 a.x1 && Q.lt a.y0 b.y1 && Q.lt b.y0 a.y1

def bbox (poly : List Vec) : Box :=
  match poly with
  | [] => ⟨Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero⟩
  | p :: ps => ps.foldl (fun b q => ⟨Q.min b.x0 q.1, Q.min b.y0 q.2, Q.max b.x1 q.1, Q.max b.y1 q.2⟩)
      ⟨p.1, p.2, p.1, p.2⟩

/-- The body rectangle of a user heading along an axis. -/
def userBox (u : RoadUser) : Option Box := do
  let p ← u.kin.position
  let h ← u.kin.heading
  let (hl, hw, _) ← u.kin.extent
  let ax := if Q.isZero h.1 then hw else hl
  let ay := if Q.isZero h.1 then hl else hw
  pure ⟨Q.sub p.1 ax, Q.sub p.2 ay, Q.add p.1 ax, Q.add p.2 ay⟩

def occupancy (users : List RoadUser) (structs : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match userBox u with
    | none => []
    | some b => structs.filterMap fun st =>
        match st.boundary with
        | some poly => if overlaps b (bbox poly) then some (u.track, st.id) else none
        | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Structures and devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rectPts (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : List Vec := [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

def interS : Structure := Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 10)
def laneC : Structure := Build.lane 11 (rectPts (m 0) (m (-60)) (m 4) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def stopLineS : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 12 .stopLine (m 0) (m (-11)) (m 4) (cm (-1050)) with entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true }
def laneOpp : Structure := Build.lane 13 (rectPts (m (-4)) (m 10) (m 0) (m 60)) Build.south (enters := some 10)
def cwNorth : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 14 .crosswalk (m (-10)) (m 11) (m 10) (m 14) with
    entranceOf := [13], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }
def laneC2 : Structure := Build.lane 15 (rectPts (m 4) (m (-60)) (m 8) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def cwSouth : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 16 .crosswalk (m (-10)) (m (-14)) (m 10) (m (-11)) with
    entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }

/-- A stop line on the opposite lane, marking that lane only. -/
def stopLineOpp : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 17 .stopLine (m (-4)) (cm 1450) (m 0) (m 15) with entranceOf := [13], entranceObserved := true }

def baseStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, stopLineS, laneOpp, cwNorth]
def cwStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, laneOpp, cwNorth, cwSouth]
def noMarkStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, laneOpp, cwNorth, stopLineOpp]

def head2 : Device := Build.signal 31 [15] [.circularGreen]
def turnSign (code : SignCode) (gov : List RegionId) : Device :=
  { Build.sign 32 .regulatorySign gov with code := some code, conditions := some {} }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Displays
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def steady (dir : ArrowDir) : List SignalIndication := [.circularRed, .greenArrow dir]
/-- Two rises of red-with-arrow during the wait (frames 30 and 40). -/
def dispCycles (dir : ArrowDir) (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady dir
  else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady dir
/-- One rise only (frame 30). -/
def dispOnce (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else steady .left
/-- Two rises, but circular_green for frames 35–37 of the wait. -/
def dispGreenInWait (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady .left
  else if k < 38 then [.circularGreen] else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady .left

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Motion profiles: distance travelled and speed by frame
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def profHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ kh then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk k)
  else if k ≤ kg then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)
  else Q.add (Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - kg)))
def speedHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < kh then Units.metresPerSecond 4 else if k ≤ kg then Q.zero else Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profConst (k : Nat) : Q := Q.mul (cm 50) (qk k)
def speedConst (_k : Nat) : Q := Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ ks then Q.mul (mm 25) (qk k) else Q.add (Q.mul (mm 25) (qk ks)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - ks)))
def speedSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < ks then cm 50 else Units.metresPerSecond 10

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A scene configuration
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Cfg where
  n : Nat := 100
  yStart : Q
  dist : Nat → Q
  speed : Nat → Q
  /-- 0 straight, 1 left, −1 right; the turn is made at `yTurn`, the yaw rate set over frames
      `yawFrom`…`yawTo` (±90 deg/s, 20 frames: ±90 degrees). -/
  turn : Int := 0
  yTurn : Q := cm (-575)
  yawFrom : Nat := 56
  yawTo : Nat := 75
  /-- Lane change to x = 6 (lane c2) once the reference point reaches this y. -/
  xShiftY : Option Q := none
  display : Nat → List SignalIndication
  headGov : List RegionId := [11]
  withHead2 : Bool := false
  sign : Option Device := none
  extraDevs : List Device := []
  structs : List Structure := baseStructs
  others : Nat → List RoadUser := fun _ => []
  subjClasses : List RoadUserClass := [.motorcycle]

def subjectAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let d := c.dist k
  let y := Q.add c.yStart d
  let dTurn := Q.sub c.yTurn c.yStart
  let x0 : Q := match c.xShiftY with
    | some ys => if Q.le ys y then m 6 else m 2
    | none => m 2
  let straight := c.turn == 0 || Q.le d dTurn
  let pos : Vec :=
    if straight then (x0, y)
    else if c.turn > 0 then (Q.sub x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
    else (Q.add x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
  let hd : Vec := if straight then Build.north else if c.turn > 0 then Build.west else Build.east
  let yaw : Q :=
    if c.turn != 0 && decide (c.yawFrom ≤ k) && decide (k ≤ c.yawTo) then
      (if c.turn > 0 then Units.degrees 90 else Units.degrees (-90))
    else Q.zero
  Build.withKin (Build.user 1 c.subjClasses pos hd (c.speed k) (m 1, cm 40, cm 70))
    fun kin => { kin with yawRate := some yaw }

def sceneAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) (t : Timestamp) : Scene :=
  let users := subjectAt c k :: c.others k
  let devs := [Build.signal 30 c.headGov (c.display k)] ++ (if c.withHead2 then [head2] else []) ++
    c.sign.toList ++ c.extraDevs
  Build.scene t (some 1) users c.structs devs (occupies := some (occupancy users c.structs))

def traceOf (c : Cfg) : Trace := Build.trace c.n 0 (Units.milliseconds 50) (sceneAt c)
def windowOf (c : Cfg) : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := some (50, Int.ofNat ((c.n - 1) * 50))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Other road users
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def ped (pos : Vec) (hd : Vec) (v : Q) : RoadUser := Build.user 2 [.pedestrian] pos hd v (cm 30, cm 30, cm 90)
def car (x : Q) : RoadUser := Build.user 3 [.motorVehicle] (x, m 3) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 8) (cm 225, m 1, cm 75)

/-- Standing in the north crosswalk (marking the opposite lane), 2 m left of the motorcycle's line. -/
def pedStanding (_k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [ped (m 0, cm 1250) Build.west Q.zero]
/-- North of the crosswalk until frame 50, then walking south at 1.5 m/s into it (from frame 67),
    1.5 m right of the motorcycle's line. -/
def pedCrossing (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  if k ≤ 50 then [ped (cm 350, cm 1550) Build.south Q.zero]
  else [ped (cm 350, Q.sub (cm 1550) (Q.mul (mm 75) (qk (k - 50)))) Build.south (cm 150)]
/-- In the north crosswalk at the start, walking west at 1.5 m/s; off it from frame 35. -/
def pedLeaving (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  [ped (Q.sub (m (-8)) (Q.mul (mm 75) (qk k)), cm 1250) Build.west (cm 150)]

            , .count (.and red anyArrow) halted .ge twoCycles
            , .since (.and atRestThere (.not green)) (.not halted) ])

    (.not (.existsDevice (.lit "regulatory_sign") "g"
      (.and (.atom "dev_regulatory_sign_code" [.var "g", .lit code] [])

/-

  Geometry (metres, +x east, +y north). Intersection i (10): the square x −10…10, y −10…10.

  south, entering i; north crosswalk (14): x −10…10, y 11…14, recorded as marking lane 13.
  Branch scenes add a south crosswalk (16, y −14…−11, marking c) or remove the marks, or add a

  The head (30) governs c and shows the display of each scene; a regulatory sign (32) governs c or i.

  sampled at 50 ms (the step bound of the turn concepts), so the integration of the yaw rate
  (observed, zero when straight) is defined across the passage. Occupancy is stated from the body
  rectangle (a body across c and i at its entry overlaps both).
  Halting scenes: approach at 4 m/s from 5 m behind the halt point (the first frames are the
  approach start: the body is more than 2 m short of the mark), at rest from frame 25 to 45 with
  its front 1.25 m short of the mark, then 10 m/s: entry at frame 50, straight exit at frame 94.
  Non-halting scenes: 10 m/s from y = −25. Display cycles: red alone, then red with the arrow from
  frame 30, red alone from 35, red with the arrow from 40 (two rises during the wait); the forbid
  display rises once (frame 30).

  so its entries and exits are not decided.

import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_307_9b
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_307_9b

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mm (n : Int) : Q := Units.millimetres n
def qk (k : Nat) : Q := Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy from body rectangles
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Box where
  x0 : Q
  y0 : Q
  x1 : Q
  y1 : Q

def overlaps (a b : Box) : Bool :=
  Q.lt a.x0 b.x1 && Q.lt b.x0 a.x1 && Q.lt a.y0 b.y1 && Q.lt b.y0 a.y1

def bbox (poly : List Vec) : Box :=
  match poly with
  | [] => ⟨Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero, Q.zero⟩
  | p :: ps => ps.foldl (fun b q => ⟨Q.min b.x0 q.1, Q.min b.y0 q.2, Q.max b.x1 q.1, Q.max b.y1 q.2⟩)
      ⟨p.1, p.2, p.1, p.2⟩

/-- The body rectangle of a user heading along an axis. -/
def userBox (u : RoadUser) : Option Box := do
  let p ← u.kin.position
  let h ← u.kin.heading
  let (hl, hw, _) ← u.kin.extent
  let ax := if Q.isZero h.1 then hw else hl
  let ay := if Q.isZero h.1 then hl else hw
  pure ⟨Q.sub p.1 ax, Q.sub p.2 ay, Q.add p.1 ax, Q.add p.2 ay⟩

def occupancy (users : List RoadUser) (structs : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match userBox u with
    | none => []
    | some b => structs.filterMap fun st =>
        match st.boundary with
        | some poly => if overlaps b (bbox poly) then some (u.track, st.id) else none
        | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Structures and devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rectPts (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : List Vec := [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

def interS : Structure := Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 10)
def laneC : Structure := Build.lane 11 (rectPts (m 0) (m (-60)) (m 4) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def stopLineS : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 12 .stopLine (m 0) (m (-11)) (m 4) (cm (-1050)) with entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true }
def laneOpp : Structure := Build.lane 13 (rectPts (m (-4)) (m 10) (m 0) (m 60)) Build.south (enters := some 10)
def cwNorth : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 14 .crosswalk (m (-10)) (m 11) (m 10) (m 14) with
    entranceOf := [13], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }
def laneC2 : Structure := Build.lane 15 (rectPts (m 4) (m (-60)) (m 8) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10)
def cwSouth : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 16 .crosswalk (m (-10)) (m (-14)) (m 10) (m (-11)) with
    entranceOf := [11], entranceObserved := true, marked := some true }

/-- A stop line on the opposite lane, marking that lane only. -/
def stopLineOpp : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 17 .stopLine (m (-4)) (cm 1450) (m 0) (m 15) with entranceOf := [13], entranceObserved := true }

def baseStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, stopLineS, laneOpp, cwNorth]
def cwStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, laneOpp, cwNorth, cwSouth]
def noMarkStructs : List Structure := [interS, laneC, laneOpp, cwNorth, stopLineOpp]

def head2 : Device := Build.signal 31 [15] [.circularGreen]
def turnSign (code : SignCode) (gov : List RegionId) : Device :=
  { Build.sign 32 .regulatorySign gov with code := some code, conditions := some {} }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Displays
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def steady (dir : ArrowDir) : List SignalIndication := [.circularRed, .greenArrow dir]
/-- Two rises of red-with-arrow during the wait (frames 30 and 40). -/
def dispCycles (dir : ArrowDir) (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady dir
  else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady dir
/-- One rise only (frame 30). -/
def dispOnce (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else steady .left
/-- Two rises, but circular_green for frames 35–37 of the wait. -/
def dispGreenInWait (k : Nat) : List SignalIndication :=
  if k < 30 then [.circularRed] else if k < 35 then steady .left
  else if k < 38 then [.circularGreen] else if k < 40 then [.circularRed] else steady .left

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Motion profiles: distance travelled and speed by frame
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def profHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ kh then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk k)
  else if k ≤ kg then Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)
  else Q.add (Q.mul (cm 20) (qk kh)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - kg)))
def speedHalt (kh kg : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < kh then Units.metresPerSecond 4 else if k ≤ kg then Q.zero else Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profConst (k : Nat) : Q := Q.mul (cm 50) (qk k)
def speedConst (_k : Nat) : Q := Units.metresPerSecond 10
def profSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k ≤ ks then Q.mul (mm 25) (qk k) else Q.add (Q.mul (mm 25) (qk ks)) (Q.mul (cm 50) (qk (k - ks)))
def speedSlow (ks : Nat) (k : Nat) : Q :=

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A scene configuration
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
structure Cfg where
  n : Nat := 100
  yStart : Q
  dist : Nat → Q
  speed : Nat → Q
  /-- 0 straight, 1 left, −1 right; the turn is made at `yTurn`, the yaw rate set over frames
      `yawFrom`…`yawTo` (±90 deg/s, 20 frames: ±90 degrees). -/
  turn : Int := 0
  yTurn : Q := cm (-575)
  yawFrom : Nat := 56
  yawTo : Nat := 75
  /-- Lane change to x = 6 (lane c2) once the reference point reaches this y. -/
  xShiftY : Option Q := none
  display : Nat → List SignalIndication
  headGov : List RegionId := [11]
  withHead2 : Bool := false
  sign : Option Device := none
  extraDevs : List Device := []
  structs : List Structure := baseStructs
  others : Nat → List RoadUser := fun _ => []
  subjClasses : List RoadUserClass := [.motorcycle]

def subjectAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let d := c.dist k
  let y := Q.add c.yStart d
  let dTurn := Q.sub c.yTurn c.yStart
  let x0 : Q := match c.xShiftY with
    | some ys => if Q.le ys y then m 6 else m 2
    | none => m 2
  let straight := c.turn == 0 || Q.le d dTurn
  let pos : Vec :=
    if straight then (x0, y)
    else if c.turn > 0 then (Q.sub x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
    else (Q.add x0 (Q.sub d dTurn), c.yTurn)
  let hd : Vec := if straight then Build.north else if c.turn > 0 then Build.west else Build.east
  let yaw : Q :=
    if c.turn != 0 && decide (c.yawFrom ≤ k) && decide (k ≤ c.yawTo) then
      (if c.turn > 0 then Units.degrees 90 else Units.degrees (-90))
    else Q.zero
  Build.withKin (Build.user 1 c.subjClasses pos hd (c.speed k) (m 1, cm 40, cm 70))
    fun kin => { kin with yawRate := some yaw }

def sceneAt (c : Cfg) (k : Nat) (t : Timestamp) : Scene :=
  let users := subjectAt c k :: c.others k
  let devs := [Build.signal 30 c.headGov (c.display k)] ++ (if c.withHead2 then [head2] else []) ++
    c.sign.toList ++ c.extraDevs
  Build.scene t (some 1) users c.structs devs (occupies := some (occupancy users c.structs))

def traceOf (c : Cfg) : Trace := Build.trace c.n 0 (Units.milliseconds 50) (sceneAt c)
def windowOf (c : Cfg) : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := some (50, Int.ofNat ((c.n - 1) * 50))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Other road users
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def ped (pos : Vec) (hd : Vec) (v : Q) : RoadUser := Build.user 2 [.pedestrian] pos hd v (cm 30, cm 30, cm 90)
def car (x : Q) : RoadUser := Build.user 3 [.motorVehicle] (x, m 3) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 8) (cm 225, m 1, cm 75)

/-- Standing in the north crosswalk (marking the opposite lane), 2 m left of the motorcycle's line. -/
def pedStanding (_k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [ped (m 0, cm 1250) Build.west Q.zero]
/-- North of the crosswalk until frame 50, then walking south at 1.5 m/s into it (from frame 67),
    1.5 m right of the motorcycle's line. -/
def pedCrossing (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  if k ≤ 50 then [ped (cm 350, cm 1550) Build.south Q.zero]
  else [ped (cm 350, Q.sub (cm 1550) (Q.mul (mm 75) (qk (k - 50)))) Build.south (cm 150)]
/-- In the north crosswalk at the start, walking west at 1.5 m/s; off it from frame 35. -/
def pedLeaving (k : Nat) : List RoadUser :=
  [ped (Q.sub (m (-8)) (Q.mul (mm 75) (qk k)), cm 1250) Build.west (cm 150)]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, 8 m/s, entering i at frame 51 on a course whose centre miss distance with
    the motorcycle is 2.7 m. -/
def carConflict (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (cm (-1250)) (Q.mul (cm 40) (Q.sub (qk k) (qk 50))))]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, out of i from frame 44. -/
def carGone (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (m (-5)) (Q.mul (cm 40) (qk k)))]
/-- Eastbound at y = 3, already past the motorcycle's line at its entry and moving away; in i until frame 70. -/
def carAhead (k : Nat) : List RoadUser := [car (Q.add (m 4) (Q.mul (cm 40) (Q.sub (qk k) (qk 50))))]

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Configurations
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def permitCfg : Cfg :=
  { yStart := cm (-1825), dist := profHalt 25 45, speed := speedHalt 25 45, display := dispCycles .left }
def forbidCfg : Cfg := { permitCfg with display := dispOnce }
def runCfg : Cfg :=
  { yStart := m (-25), dist := profConst, speed := speedConst, display := fun _ => steady .left }

/-- `forbid` (violated): A motorcycle (ru.aggregate motorcycle) occupies approach lane c entering i, with a stop line recorded as marking c; the head governing c displays circular_red with green_arrow(left). The motorcycle halts at the stop line, waits while the red-with-arrow display comes on again once only, then enters i and exits straight ahead (no turn concept holds). No pedestrian or other road user is present. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace := traceOf forbidCfg

/-- `permit` (compliant): As in forbid, but the motorcycle remains at rest at the stop line while the red-with-arrow display rises twice, the head never displays circular_green, and it then proceeds straight through i. No other road user is in the scene, so the yield is decided on the subject alone. -/
def permitTrace : Trace := traceOf permitCfg

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The head governing c displays circular_green at the motorcycle's entry; it proceeds straight through. -/
def idleCfg : Cfg := { runCfg with display := fun _ => [.circularGreen] }
def idleTrace : Trace := traceOf idleCfg

/-- `blind` (unknown): As in forbid, but the state of the head governing c is never observed (dev.traffic_signal absent). -/
def blindTrace : Trace := traceOf forbidCfg

/-- `history_boundary` (unknown): The recording begins with the motorcycle already within the stop line's stopping zone on c, moving slowly, under red with green_arrow(left); it enters i and exits straight. No halt is recorded, the approach start and any earlier wait lie before the recording, and no earlier entry into i is recorded. -/
def historyCfg : Cfg :=
